listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 134m², Budva, Crna Gora
Sale, two bedroom apartment, 134m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Predstavljamo vam dvosoban stan povrsine 134.55m2 koji je lociran na 6. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.
Rok zavrsetka april 2028.
Raspored plaćanja je sledeći:-Rezervacija: 10.000 € (nepovratno)-30% kupoprodajne cene – u roku od 10 dana od potpisivanja Preliminarnog ugovoraPreostali iznos kupci plaćaju u tri rate:Prva rata 30% – nakon završetka konstrukcijeDruga rata 30% – nakon završetka završnih radovaTreća rata 10% – prilikom primopredaje nekretnineOvaj jedinstveni kompleks nalazi se u samom epicentru turističke Budve, na šetalištu, okružen fantastičnim prirodnim uslovima kao što je neopisiv panoramski pogled koji prepliće najbolje od Budvanske rivijere sa modernim objektima, sadržajima i uslugama hotela sa 5 zvjezdica. Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo dizajnirani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Deseti sprat je isključivo posvećen penthaus apartmanima, koji se mogu pohvaliti raskošnim sadržajima kao što su hidromasažne kade i prostrane terase. Ukupno ima 66 apartmana dostupnih za kupovinu uključujući sobe, apartmane i penthaus apartmaneKompleks poseduje dva ulaza, jedan pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi pristupačan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, koji se nalazi u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama. Sadržaji KompleksaKompleks nudi poslovni prostor, prodavnice i servisni centar, dva restorana i kafić sa pogledom na Jadransko more, spa centar sa bazenima i teretanom, kao i konferencijske sadržaje. Podzemni objekti obuhvataju tehničke prostorije, kao i podzemni parking sa ukupno 160 parking mjesta. Usluge i SigurnostKonsijerž i 24-časovno obezbjeđenje jamče vaš mir i sigurnost. Naša raznolika ponuda hotela s pet zvjezdica i sadržaja Budve pretvara vašu investiciju u luksuzni stil života. Zelena OazaOvaj savremeni objekat također nudi zelenu oazu na krovu konferencijske sale, gdje ćete uživati u prirodi.
Poseban fokus stavljen je na održavanje zelenih površina, koje će vlasnicima i gostima omogućiti sezonsko uživanje u prirodi i lokalnoj flori na kućnom pragu. Pogodnosti-DVA HOTELSKA RESTORANA,KAFIĆ KANCELARIJE I PRODAVNICE NA PRVIM SPRATOVIMA.-SPA CENTAR SA TERETANOM I BAZENIMA ZELENA OAZA NA KROVU BRENDIRANE REZIDENCIJE.-Tehničke prostorije i podzemni parking-Brendirane rezidencije s uslugom održavanja-Paketi namještaja dostupni za useljenje

We present to you a two bedroom apartment with an area of 134.55m2, which is located on the 6nd floor of a complex under construction on the first line of the sea in Budva.
Completion Date: April 2028Payment Schedule:Reservation: €10,000 (non-refundable)30% of the purchase price – within 10 days of signing the Preliminary AgreementThe remaining amount is paid in three installments:First installment 30% – after completion of the structural constructionSecond installment 30% – after completion of the finishing worksThird installment 10% – upon handover of the propertyThis unique complex is located in the very heart of tourist Budva, on the promenade, surrounded by fantastic natural conditions and offering an indescribable panoramic view that combines the best of the Budva Riviera with modern facilities, amenities, and five-star hotel services.
The residential units available for sale are located from the 4th to the 9th floor. These carefully designed apartments provide a perfect blend of luxury and functionality, with stunning views of the surroundings. The 10th floor is exclusively dedicated to penthouse apartments, featuring luxurious amenities such as jacuzzis and spacious terraces.
In total, there are 66 apartments available for purchase, including standard units, apartments, and penthouses.
The complex has two entrances, one conveniently located on the promenade and another accessible from the boulevard. The main entrance, located in the annex of the congress center, provides easy access to various events and conferences.
Complex Amenities:The complex offers commercial spaces, shops, and a service center, two restaurants and a café with a view of the Adriatic Sea, a spa center with pools and a gym, as well as conference facilities. The underground facilities include technical rooms and an underground parking area with a total of 160 parking spaces.
Services and Security:Concierge and 24-hour security ensure peace of mind and safety. The diverse offering of five-star hotels and amenities in Budva turns your investment into a luxurious lifestyle.
Green Oasis:This modern building also features a green oasis on the roof of the conference hall, where residents can enjoy nature. Special attention is given to maintaining green spaces, allowing owners and guests to enjoy seasonal greenery and local flora at their doorstep.
Additional Benefits:Two hotel restaurants, café, offices, and shops on the lower floorsSpa center with gym and pools, green rooftop oasis, branded residencesTechnical rooms and underground parkingBranded residences with maintenance servicesFurniture packages available for move-in

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Nekretnine Crna Gora,Tivat-Predstavljamo vam novi rezidencijalni kompleks koji se nalazi u srcu Porto Montenegra, u kvartu Sinhro grada Tivta. Ovaj projekat nekretnina je magični spoj elegancije, udobnosti i najsavremenijeg dizajna, kreiran da ispuni sva vaša očekivanja i još mnogo toga.
Projekat obuhvata tri stambena bloka i krovni bazen koji povezuje dva odvojena bloka. Svaka zgrada ima luksuzne stanove i prostrane penthause, savršeno projektovane od najkvalitetnijih materijala.
Možete birati između 40 različitih stanova u rasponu od jednosobnih 49m2 do fantastičnih penthouse apartmana od 321m2.
Na prodaju je i 6 poslovnih jedinica.
Usluge i pogodnosti:• Privatni konsijerž• Infiniti bazen na krovu• Privatno obezbeđenje• Podzemna garaža• Namenske skladišne jedinice• Sistem pametne kućeOsnovni paket uključuje elegantan dizajn enterijera, sa mogućnošću izbora između dva stila - italijanskog i nordijskog. Dodatno, na zahtev, svaki stan može biti opremljen i opremljen najkvalitetnijim nameštajem i opremom.
Kompleks se nalazi pored luksuzne marine za mega-jahte Porto Montenegro iu neposrednoj blizini međunarodnih škola i aerodroma u Tivtu, Podgorici i Dubrovniku.
Pored nagrađivane marine, Porto Montenegro se može pohvaliti šarmantnim rezidencijalnim delom, hotelom Regent sa pet zvezdica, luksuznim buticima, prodavnicama, restoranima, sportskim i rekreativnim sadržajima, koji privlače živu međunarodnu zajednicu tokom cele godine.
Ulaganje u sigurnost i prosperitetUlaganjem u projekat obezbeđujete zagarantovan povraćaj uloženih sredstava od 6% godišnje. Ovo je prilika za pametno ulaganje, kombinujući luksuz sa finansijskom sigurnošću.
Dodatno, na zahtjev klijenta, svaki apartman može biti u cjelosti opremljen najkvalitetnijim namještajem i ugradnim elementima. Trenutno postoje 2 posebne ponude:Prilikom potpisivanja kupoprodajnog ugovora pre 1. juna 2025. godine, svaki apartman na poklon dobija parking mesto u podzemnoj garazi i individualnu ostavu.
Pri kupovini rezidencija 106, 108, 113, 403 i 404 - kompletno opremanje i namještaj na poklon!#NekretnineCrnaGora #Tivat #PortoMontenegro #PogledNaMore #Investicija #NovKompleksSaBazenom #LuksuzniStanovi #StanoviUIzgradnji

Exclusive Residential Living in Porto Montenegro, Tivat
Discover an exceptional residential development in the prestigious Synchro district of Porto Montenegro, where modern architecture, timeless elegance and the Mediterranean lifestyle meet in one of the Adriatic’s most desirable locations.
A New Vision of Luxury Living
Designed to combine sophistication, comfort and functionality, the development consists of three residential buildings, with a spectacular rooftop infinity pool connecting two of the buildings. Each residence features carefully selected materials, elegant finishes and contemporary design, creating an exclusive living environment.
Residences Tailored to Your Lifestyle
* 40 luxury apartments, ranging from 49 m² one-bedroom residences to impressive 321 m² penthouses * 6 commercial units available for purchase * Two refined interior design concepts: Italian and Nordic * Optional bespoke furnishing and complete interior fit-out
Whether you are seeking an elegant waterfront home, a holiday residence or a premium real estate investment, the development offers a range of options to suit different lifestyles and preferences.
Exceptional Amenities and Services
Residents can enjoy a range of premium facilities designed to enhance everyday comfort and convenience:
* Private concierge service * Rooftop infinity swimming pool * 24/7 private security * Underground parking garage * Private storage units * Smart home technology
Every detail is designed to provide a seamless residential experience in an exclusive setting.
An Outstanding Location
Located just moments from the renowned Porto Montenegro superyacht marina, the development places residents at the centre of Tivat’s vibrant waterfront lifestyle.
Luxury boutiques, fine dining restaurants, the five-star Regent Hotel, sports and recreational facilities, and international schools are all within easy reach.
Tivat International Airport is just a short drive away, while Podgorica and Dubrovnik airports provide additional international travel connections.
A Prestigious Address with Investment Potential
Porto Montenegro is one of the Adriatic’s most sought-after luxury destinations, combining a world-class marina, elegant waterfront residences and a vibrant international community throughout the year.
The project has been promoted with an annual return on investment of 6%. Prospective investors should confirm the current terms and request details of any contractual guarantees, conditions and associated risks before making an investment decision.
Exclusive Purchase Opportunities
Special purchase incentives may be available, subject to current availability and the developer’s terms.
Previous promotional offers included underground parking and private storage, as well as complimentary furnishing and interior decoration for selected residences. These offers were subject to specific deadlines and conditions, so their current availability should be confirmed directly with the sales team.
Discover Your Place in Porto Montenegro
Whether you are looking for a prestigious residence on the Adriatic coast, an elegant holiday home or a property with investment potential, this development offers the opportunity to experience contemporary luxury living in the heart of Tivat.
Contact us for the latest availability, apartment layouts, prices and detailed investment information.

Luxury Real Estate in Porto Montenegro, Tivat
Discover an exclusive residential development in the prestigious Synchro district of Porto Montenegro, where contemporary architecture, sophisticated design and Mediterranean living come together in an exceptional waterfront setting.
Contemporary Design Meets Refined Elegance
The development comprises three residential buildings, with a spectacular rooftop swimming pool connecting two of the blocks. Each residence is thoughtfully designed using premium materials, elegant finishes and modern architectural elements to create a refined and comfortable living environment.

Na prodaju ekskluzivan duplex apartman ukupne površine 119 m², smešten u luksuznom boutique kompleksu The Cube u Krašićima, na poluostrvu Luštica. Ova moderna nekretnina pruža savršen spoj savremenog dizajna, privatnosti i vrhunskog kvaliteta života, uz spektakularan panoramski pogled na more i planine.
Kompleks se nalazi u mirnom delu Krašića i predstavlja jedinstvenu privatnu celinu sa svega 9 apartmana i 2 luksuzne vile, čime se obezbeđuje visok nivo komfora i ekskluzivnosti. Smešten je na odličnoj lokaciji, oko 15 minuta vožnje od Aerodroma Tivat i nekoliko minuta od prestižnog kompleksa Luštica Bay.
Apartman se prostire na dve etaže. Na prvom nivou nalazi se prostrani dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, gostinski toalet i izlaz na veliku terasu sa otvorenim panoramskim pogledom. Na drugom nivou smeštene su dve komforne spavaće sobe, pri čemu svaka soba poseduje svoje privatno kupatilo, pružajući dodatnu udobnost i privatnost. Na ovoj etaži se nalazi i tehnička prostorija sa veš mašinom, bojlerom i dodatnim prostorom za odlaganje.
Apartman je završen i spreman za useljenje. Projektovan je sa velikim staklenim površinama koje omogućavaju obilje prirodne svetlosti i nesmetan pogled na Jadransko more i okolne planine.
Stanari kompleksa imaju na raspolaganju zajednički bazen dužine 20 metara koji se održava tokom cele godine, kao i dve uređene lounge zone za odmor. Posebna prednost kompleksa je što vile imaju sopstvene bazene i garažna mesta, dok glavni bazen koriste isključivo vlasnici apartmana, što dodatno doprinosi privatnosti.
Nekretnina poseduje kompletnu dokumentaciju. Garažno parking mesto dostupno je uz doplatu.

Exclusive Duplex Apartment for Sale in Krašići, Luštica Peninsula
Discover an exceptional duplex apartment in an exclusive boutique residential complex in Krašići on the Luštica Peninsula. Offering 119 m² of living space, this contemporary residence combines elegant design, privacy and Mediterranean charm, complemented by breathtaking panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and surrounding mountains.

Situated in a peaceful and picturesque setting, the complex comprises just nine apartments and two luxury villas, offering residents a private and tranquil living environment.
The property enjoys an excellent location, approximately 15 minutes by car from Tivat International Airport and just a short drive from the prestigious Luštica Bay development.
Contemporary Living Across Two Levels
The apartment is arranged over two floors, with a thoughtfully designed layout that maximises comfort, functionality and natural light.
Ground Floor
* Spacious open-plan living area * Modern kitchen and dining area * Guest toilet * Large terrace with panoramic sea and mountain views
Upper Floor
* Two comfortable bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom * Dedicated utility room with a washing machine, boiler and additional storage space
Large glass surfaces fill the interiors with natural light, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere while framing the spectacular Adriatic scenery.
Exclusive Amenities and Privacy
Residents enjoy access to a 20-metre swimming pool, maintained throughout the year, as well as two furnished relaxation areas designed for outdoor leisure.
The complex offers a particularly attractive level of privacy: the villas feature their own private swimming pools and garage spaces, while the main swimming pool is reserved exclusively for apartment owners.
Ready to Move In
The apartment is fully completed and ready for immediate occupancy, making it an excellent choice as a permanent residence, a holiday home or a real estate investment on Montenegro’s Adriatic coast.
The property has complete documentation, and a garage parking space is available for purchase at an additional cost.
A rare opportunity to own an elegant duplex residence in an exclusive boutique development, surrounded by natural beauty and offering spectacular panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea.

Možete birati između 40 različitih stanova u rasponu od jednosobnih 49m2 do fantastičnih penthouse apartmana od 321m2.
Na prodaju je i 6 poslovnih jedinica.
Usluge i pogodnosti:• Privatni konsijerž• Infiniti bazen na krovu• Privatno obezbeđenje• Podzemna garaža• Namenske skladišne jedinice• Sistem pametne kućeOsnovni paket uključuje elegantan dizajn enterijera, sa mogućnošću izbora između dva stila - italijanskog i nordijskog. Dodatno, na zahtev, svaki stan može biti opremljen i opremljen najkvalitetnijim nameštajem i opremom.
Kompleks se nalazi pored luksuzne marine za mega-jahte Porto Montenegro iu neposrednoj blizini međunarodnih škola i aerodroma u Tivtu, Podgorici i Dubrovniku.
Pored nagrađivane marine, Porto Montenegro se može pohvaliti šarmantnim rezidencijalnim delom, hotelom Regent sa pet zvezdica, luksuznim buticima, prodavnicama, restoranima, sportskim i rekreativnim sadržajima, koji privlače živu međunarodnu zajednicu tokom cele godine.
Ulaganje u sigurnost i prosperitetUlaganjem u projekat obezbeđujete zagarantovan povraćaj uloženih sredstava od 6% godišnje. Ovo je prilika za pametno ulaganje, kombinujući luksuz sa finansijskom sigurnošću.

We present to you a new residential complex located in the heart of Porto Montenegro, in the Synchro neighborhood of the city of Tivat. This real estate project is a magical blend of elegance, comfort and state-of-the-art design, created to meet all your expectations and more.
When signing the sales contract before June 1, 2025, each apartment comes with a complimentary parking space in the underground garage and a private storage room.
For the purchase of residences 106, 108, 113, 403, and 404 – full furnishing and interior decoration included as a gift!
The project includes three residential blocks and a rooftop swimming pool connecting two separate blocks. Each building has luxurious apartments and spacious penthouses, perfectly designed from the highest quality materials.
You can choose from 40 different apartments ranging from one bedroom 49m2 to fantastic penthouse apartments of 321m2.6 business units are also for sale.
Services and benefits:• Private concierge• Infinity pool on the roof• Private security• Underground garage• Dedicated storage units• Smart home systemThe basic package includes an elegant interior design, with the option of choosing between two styles - Italian and Nordic. Additionally, upon request, each apartment can be furnished and equipped with the highest quality furniture and equipment.
The complex is located next to the luxury marina for mega-yachts Porto Montenegro and in the immediate vicinity of international schools and airports in Tivat, Podgorica and Dubrovnik.
In addition to an award-winning marina, Porto Montenegro boasts a charming residential area, the five-star Regent Hotel, luxury boutiques, shops, restaurants, sports and recreational facilities, which attract a vibrant international community throughout the year.
Investing in security and prosperityBy investing in the project, you ensure a guaranteed return on invested funds of 6% per year. This is an opportunity for a smart investment, combining luxury with financial security.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 223m², Reževići, Budva
Sale, house, 223m², Reževići, Budva
listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 223 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 306 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata četiri spavaće sobe, cetiri kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 223 m² with a private plot of 306 m² and a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes four bedrooms, four bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of space and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. The plot features a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of high-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for rental.

Uz 24h obezbjeđenje i concierge usluge, stan nudi potpunu udobnost i sigurnost, idealan za život, odmor ili investiciju.

In the modern complex Tivat Hotel & Residences, located in an attractive location in Seljanovo, there is a spacious two-bedroom apartment of 107 m2. The apartment consists of a living room with a kitchen and dining room, two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a terrace.
The complex is located on the site of a former hotel from the 1970s, just a few minutes' walk from the sea and the city beach. Around the building are landscaped gardens, a park, and a children's playground, while rooftop pools and bars offer a view of the Tivat Riviera.
With 24h security and concierge services, the apartment offers complete comfort and security, ideal for living, vacation, or investment.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 58m², Bečići, Budva
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 58m², Bečići, Budva
listing.description:
Prodaja jednosobnog stana 58 m² sa pogledom na more u ekskluzivnom stambenom kompleksu u Rafailovićima – prvi red do mora sa privatnom plažom i luksuznim sadržajimaPredstavljamo vam jedinstvenu priliku za kupovinu luksuznog stana direktno na bečićkoj plaži. Smješten na prvoj liniji mora, samo 10 metara od čuvene plaže koja važi za jednu od najlepših na Jadranu, ovaj moderan stambeni kompleks u izgradnji kombinuje vrhunski dizajn, ekskluzivne sadržaje i privatnu plažu, nudeći nezaboravno iskustvo života na moru. Stanari imaju ekskluzivan privatni pristup plaži ispred objekta, a u blizini se nalaze restorani, kafići, barovi i butici koji čine život praktičnim i zabavnim.
Kompleks nudi luksuzne sadržaje za opuštanje i zabavu, uključujući zatvoreni i otvoreni bazen sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more, moderno opremljen fitness centar, kazino na dva nivoa, potpuno opremljen wellness i spa centar, kao i maloprodajne prostore sa restoranima, kafićima, barovima i buticima.
Projektom je predviđena stambena zgrada od 12 spratova sa ukupno 136 stambenih jedinica i 95 parking mesta, dizajnirana da zadovolji najviše standarde udobnosti, privatnosti i luksuznog života na obali. Svi stanovi dolaze potpuno namješteni, opremljeni prozorima sa dvostrukim staklom za poboljšanu termo i zvučnu izolaciju, a koriste se samo najkvalitetniji materijali koji osiguravaju izuzetnu izdržljivost i komfor.
Stanovi su različitih rasporeda i veličina: od studija od 38 m², jednosobnih stanova od 53–69 m², dvosobnih od 84–113 m², do trosobnih stanova od 161–170 m². Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Mesečna naknada za održavanje iznosi 6,90 € / m².
Atraktivan model plaćanja predviđa 10% prilikom rezervacije, 60% tokom izgradnje sa završetkom u decembru 2026. godine, dok se preostali iznos od 30% plaća u maju 2027. godine, a predaja stanova je planirana u periodu mart–april 2027. Grand Opening kompleksa predviđen je za leto 2027. godine.
Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.

Luxury One-Bedroom Apartment with Sea View in Rafailovići, Montenegro
58 m² | First Line to the Sea | Private Beach | Premium Amenities | Investment Opportunity
Discover an exceptional opportunity to own a luxury one-bedroom apartment in an exclusive residential complex located directly on the stunning Bečići Riviera, in Rafailovići, Montenegro.
Situated just 10 metres from one of the Adriatic coast’s most beautiful beaches, this prestigious development combines contemporary architecture, elegant interiors, premium facilities, and breathtaking sea views. Designed for those who appreciate sophisticated coastal living, the complex offers an exclusive lifestyle with direct access to a private beach area.
Property Highlights
* Apartment size: 58 m² * Layout: One bedroom, living room, kitchen, and bathroom * View: Panoramic Adriatic Sea views * Location: First line to the sea, Rafailovići, Budva Riviera * Furnishing: Fully furnished to a high standard * Beach access: Exclusive private beach area * Status: Under construction
Exclusive Residential Amenities
Residents will enjoy an impressive selection of premium facilities designed to provide comfort, relaxation, and entertainment, including:
* Indoor and outdoor swimming pools with panoramic sea views * A modern, fully equipped fitness centre * A luxury wellness and spa centre * A two-level casino * Restaurants, cafés, bars, and boutiques within the complex * High-quality construction materials and double-glazed windows for enhanced thermal and acoustic insulation
The development comprises a modern 12-storey residential building with 136 apartments and 95 parking spaces, offering an exclusive environment for both permanent residence and holiday living.
An Attractive Investment Opportunity
In addition to its exceptional location and lifestyle benefits, this property offers significant potential as a holiday rental investment.
A professional property management model is planned, with a proposed revenue-sharing arrangement of 70% to the owner and 30% to the management company, subject to the final management agreement.
Its beachfront location, premium amenities, and appeal to international visitors make this apartment an attractive option for investors seeking rental income and long-term capital appreciation.
Payment Plan and Completion
The proposed payment schedule is structured as follows:
* 10% upon reservation * 60% during construction * 30% in May 2027
Construction completion is scheduled for December 2026, with apartment handover planned for March–April 2027. The grand opening is anticipated for summer 2027.
All construction and handover dates are subject to confirmation by the developer.
A Premium Address on the Adriatic
Whether you are looking for a luxury seaside residence, an exclusive holiday home, or an investment property in one of Montenegro’s most desirable coastal destinations, this 58 m² apartment represents an opportunity to enjoy the best of the Budva Riviera.
Experience the perfect combination of sea views, beachfront living, premium amenities, and investment potential in the heart of Rafailovići.
Contact us today for pricing, availability, floor plans, and further information.

Sale of a One-Bedroom Apartment 58 m² with Sea View in an Exclusive Residential Complex in Rafailovići – First Line to the Sea with Private Beach and Luxury AmenitiesWe present a unique opportunity to purchase a luxury apartment directly on Bečići Beach. Located on the first line to the sea, just 10 meters from the famous beach considered one of the most beautiful on the Adriatic, this modern residential complex under construction combines top-quality design, exclusive amenities, and a private beach, offering an unforgettable seaside living experience. Luxury One-Bedroom Apartment for Sale – 56 m² in Rafailovići, Montenegro
Prime Beachfront Location | Private Beach Access | Luxury Amenities | Investment Potential
Discover an exceptional opportunity to own a luxury one-bedroom apartment in an exclusive residential complex in Rafailovići, on the stunning Budva Riviera in Montenegro.
Located on the first line to the sea, just 10 metres from the beautiful Bečići Beach, this prestigious development combines contemporary architecture, elegant interiors, premium amenities, and an outstanding coastal location. Designed for those who appreciate refined seaside living, the complex offers an exclusive lifestyle with private beach access and breathtaking views of the Adriatic.
Property Highlights
* Apartment size: 56 m² * Layout: One bedroom, living area, kitchen, and bathroom * Location: Rafailovići, Budva Riviera, Montenegro * Beach proximity: Approximately 10 metres from Bečići Beach * Furnishing: Fully furnished * Beach access: Exclusive access to the private beach area * Building status: Under construction
Premium Amenities and Facilities
The residential complex is designed to provide residents with a luxurious lifestyle, offering an impressive range of facilities, including:
* Indoor and outdoor swimming pools with panoramic Adriatic Sea views * A modern, fully equipped fitness centre * A dedicated wellness and spa centre * A two-level casino * On-site restaurants, cafés, bars, and boutiques * High-quality construction materials and double-glazed windows for improved thermal and sound insulation
The development comprises a modern 12-storey building with 136 residential units and 95 parking spaces, combining contemporary design, comfort, and functionality in a sought-after beachfront setting.
Property Prices and Maintenance
The development offers a range of apartment types to suit different lifestyle preferences and investment goals:
* Studios: 38 m² * One-bedroom apartments: 53–69 m² * Two-bedroom apartments: 84–113 m² * Three-bedroom apartments: 161–170 m²
Prices across the development range from €269,000 to €1,450,000, depending on the apartment type, floor, layout, and views. The indicative price per square metre ranges from €4,700 to €8,500.
Monthly maintenance fee: €6.90 per m².
Please contact us for the current asking price and availability of this 56 m² apartment.
Flexible Payment Plan
The proposed payment schedule is structured as follows:
* 10% upon reservation * 60% during construction * 30% in May 2027
Construction completion is scheduled for December 2026, with apartment handover planned for March–April 2027. The grand opening is anticipated for summer 2027.
All dates and payment terms are subject to confirmation by the developer.
Investment Opportunity with Professional Management
In addition to offering an exceptional seaside lifestyle, this property presents an attractive opportunity for holiday rental investment.
A proposed revenue-sharing model allocates 70% of rental revenue to the owner and 30% to the management company, subject to the final management agreement.
The beachfront location, premium amenities, and appeal to international holidaymakers provide a strong foundation for rental potential. Actual occupancy, operating costs, and returns will depend on market conditions and the final management arrangements.
An Exclusive Lifestyle on the Budva Riviera
Whether you are seeking a luxury holiday home, a permanent seaside residence, or an investment property in one of Montenegro’s most desirable coastal destinations, this 56 m² apartment offers an opportunity to experience the best of Adriatic living.
Enjoy the convenience of beachfront access, the comfort of modern residential facilities, and the vibrant atmosphere of Rafailovići, with restaurants, cafés, bars, and boutiques nearby.
Contact us today for the asking price, floor plan, availability, and further details about this exclusive beachfront property.

Kompleks nudi luksuzne sadržaje za opuštanje i zabavu, uključujući zatvoreni i otvoreni bazen sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more, moderno opremljen fitness centar, kazino na dva nivoa, potpuno opremljen wellness i spa centar, kao i maloprodajne prostore sa restoranima, kafićima, barovima i buticima.
Projektom je predviđena stambena zgrada od 12 spratova sa ukupno 136 stambenih jedinica i 95 parking mesta, dizajnirana da zadovolji najviše standarde udobnosti, privatnosti i luksuznog života na obali. Svi stanovi dolaze potpuno namješteni, opremljeni prozorima sa dvostrukim staklom za poboljšanu termo i zvučnu izolaciju, a koriste se samo najkvalitetniji materijali koji osiguravaju izuzetnu izdržljivost i komfor.
Stanovi su različitih rasporeda i veličina: od studija od 38 m², jednosobnih stanova od 53–69 m², dvosobnih od 84–113 m², do trosobnih stanova od 161–170 m². Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Mesečna naknada za održavanje iznosi 6,90 € / m².
Atraktivan model plaćanja predviđa 10% prilikom rezervacije, 60% tokom izgradnje sa završetkom u decembru 2026. godine, dok se preostali iznos od 30% plaća u maju 2027. godine, a predaja stanova je planirana u periodu mart–april 2027. Grand Opening kompleksa predviđen je za leto 2027. godine.
Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.

Sale of a Two-Bedroom Apartment 113 m² in an Exclusive Modern Residential Complex in Rafailovići – First Line to the Sea with Private Beach and Luxury Amenities We present a unique opportunity to purchase a luxury apartment directly on Bečići Beach. Located on the first line to the sea, just 10 meters from the famous beach considered one of the most beautiful on the Adriatic, this modern residential complex under construction combines top-quality design, exclusive amenities, and a private beach, offering an unforgettable seaside living experience. Residents have exclusive private access to the beach in front of the building, while nearby restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques make life convenient and enjoyable.
The complex offers luxury facilities for relaxation and entertainment, including indoor and outdoor pools with panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea, a fully equipped modern fitness center, a two-level casino, a fully equipped wellness and spa center, and retail spaces with restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques.
The project features a 12-story residential building with a total of 136 residential units and 95 parking spaces, designed to meet the highest standards of comfort, privacy, and luxurious coastal living. All apartments come fully furnished, with double-glazed windows for improved thermal and sound insulation, using only the highest quality materials to ensure durability and comfort.
Apartments come in various layouts and sizes: studios of 38 m², one-bedroom apartments of 53–69 m², two-bedroom apartments of 84–113 m², and three-bedroom apartments of 161–170 m². Prices range from €269,000 to €1,450,000, defining a price per square meter of €4,700 to €8,500 depending on the type, floor, and layout. Monthly maintenance fee is €6.90/m².
The attractive payment plan includes 10% upon reservation, 60% during construction with completion in December 2026, and the remaining 30% in May 2027, with handover planned for March–April 2027. Grand Opening is scheduled for summer 2027.
Additionally, there is an attractive profit-sharing model with professional management and high expected occupancy – 70% to the owner and 30% to management, making this property ideal for both living and investment.
This is a unique opportunity for luxury living or investment on the most beautiful beach of the Budva Riviera, with exclusive amenities, a private beach, and panoramic sea views.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 824m², Gorica C, Podgorica
Sale, land lot, 824m², Gorica C, Podgorica
listing.description:
Na prodaju su dvije katastarske parcele ukupne površine 824 m². Na prvoj parceli nalazi se porodična stambena kuća površine 123 m², bez tereta i ograničenja, dok je druga parcela neizgrađena.
Prema urbanističko-tehničkim uslovima, dozvoljena je rekonstrukcija postojećeg stambenog objekta do maksimalne bruto građevinske površine utvrđene koeficijentom izgrađenosti 1, uz planiranu spratnost Su+P+1+Pk. Namjena objekta predviđena je za stanovanje, uz mogućnost obavljanja poslovne djelatnosti.
Indeksi planirane izgrađenosti i zauzetosti su sljedeći:
Maksimalni indeks zauzetosti – stanovanje: 0,30
Maksimalni indeks zauzetosti – stanovanje sa djelatnostima: 0,80
Maksimalni indeks izgrađenosti – stanovanje: 0,50
Maksimalni indeks izgrađenosti – stanovanje sa djelatnostima: 1,00
Parcele se nalaze na ravnom terenu sa niskim nivoom podzemnih voda i dobrom stabilnošću tla, što čini lokaciju izuzetno pogodnom za izgradnju i urbanizaciju.
Prema podacima Uprave za katastar i državnu imovinu, prva parcela je evidentirana kao „porodična stambena zgrada“ površine 123 m² i „dvorište“ površine 127 m², dok je druga parcela označena kao „voćnjak I klase“ površine 576 m².
Svojina je 1/1, bez upisanih tereta i ograničenja.

For sale are two cadastral land plots with a total area of 824 m². On the first land plot, there is a family residential house with an area of 123 m², without encumbrances and restrictions, while the second land plot is undeveloped.
According to urban-technical conditions, reconstruction of the existing residential building is permitted up to a maximum gross construction area determined by a building coefficient of 1, with a planned floor count of Su+P+1+Pk. The purpose of the building is intended for residential use, with the possibility of commercial activity.
The planned building and occupancy indices are as follows:
Maximum occupancy index – residential: 0.30
Maximum occupancy index – residential with activities: 0.80
Maximum building index – residential: 0.50
Maximum building index – residential with activities: 1.00
The land plots are located on flat terrain with a low groundwater level and good soil stability, which makes the location extremely suitable for construction and urbanization.
According to data from the Directorate for Cadaster and State Property, the first land plot is registered as a "family residential building" with an area of 123 m² and a "courtyard" with an area of 127 m², while the second land plot is marked as a "class I orchard" with an area of 576 m².
Ownership is 1/1, without registered encumbrances and restrictions.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 1059m², Dobrota, Kotor
Sale, land lot, 1059m², Dobrota, Kotor
listing.description:
Lokacija se nalazi u najznačajnijem dijelu naselja Dobrota, što ovu poziciju čini posebno atraktivnom za stambenu izgradnju. Prema Nacrtu urbanističko-tehničkih uslova, na predmetnom prostoru planirana je izgradnja stambenih objekata spratnosti P+1+Pk, na placu ukupne bruto građevinske površine (BRGP) od 1059 m².
Zemljište je u katastru evidentirano kao „šume II klase“, ukupne površine 1059 m².
Urbanistički parametri
Površina urbanističke parcele: 1059 m²
Maksimalni indeks zauzetosti: 0,35 (za odmak 100–1000m)
Pz = 370 m²
Maksimalni indeks izgrađenosti: 1 (za odmak 100–1000 m)
Maksimalna bruto građevinska površina objekata: 1059 m²
Minimalni procenat ozelenjenosti: 25–30%
Pomoćni objekti
Na parceli predviđenoj za izgradnju stambenog objekta dozvoljena je i izgradnja pomoćnih objekata, poput garaže, ljetnje kuhinje ili ostave.
Maksimalna spratnost: prizemna (P)
Maksimalna visina: 3,0 m
Maksimalna površina: do 30 m²
Pomoćni objekti moraju biti smješteni unutar predviđenih građevinskih linija glavnog objekta.

According to the Draft urban-technical conditions, the construction of residential buildings with P+1+Pk floors is planned on the subject area, on a land plot with a total gross construction area (BRGP) of 1059 m².
The land is registered in the cadastre as "forests of class II", with a total area of 1059 m².
Urban parameters
Area of urban plot: 1059 m²
Maximum occupancy index: 0,35 (for setback 100–1000m)
Pz = 370 m²
Maximum built-up index: 1 (for setback 100–1000 m)
Maximum gross construction area of buildings: 1059 m²
Minimum green area percentage: 25–30%
Auxiliary buildings
On the plot intended for residential building construction, the construction of auxiliary buildings is also permitted, such as a garage, summer kitchen, or storage room.
Maximum number of floors: ground floor (P)
Maximum height: 3.0 m
Maximum area: up to 30 m²
Auxiliary buildings must be located within the planned building lines of the main building.

Ukupna površina obje katastarske parcele iznosi 9.748 m² (6.197 m² + 3.551 m²), obje upisane u List nepokretnosti broj 865. Na predmetnim parcelama dozvoljena je izgrađenost od 0.80, što omogućava ukupnu bruto građevinsku površinu od 7.798 m². Planirana je izgradnja osam objekata, prosječne površine od oko 975 m² po zgradi. Ukupna cijena iznosi 1.754.640 €.
Parcele se nalaze u Krašićima, jednom od najljepših naselja na poluostrvu Luštica, u opštini Tivat. Krašići su poznati po mirnom okruženju, prelijepim plažama, kristalno čistom moru i panoramskom pogledu na Bokokotorski zaliv.

The total area of both cadastral land plots is 9.748 m² (6.197 m² + 3.551 m²), both registered in Cadastral Record number 865. On the subject land plots, a construction index of 0.80 is permitted, which allows for a total gross building area of 7.798 m². The construction of eight buildings is planned, with an average area of approximately 975 m² per building. The total price is 1.754.640 €.
The land plots are located in Krašići, one of the most beautiful neighborhoods on the Luštica peninsula, in the municipality of Tivat. Krašići is known for its peaceful surroundings, beautiful beaches, crystal clear sea, and panoramic views of the Bay of Kotor.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 23375m², Smailagića Polje, Kolašin

listing.description:

Objekat je pozicioniran na terenu sa izraženim nagibom, što je direktno uticalo na njegovu formu i funkcionalnu organizaciju. Arhitektonsko oblikovanje nadahnuto je lokalnom vernakularnom arhitekturom, sa fasadom obloženom drvenim letvama i dekorativnim mrežama, koje daju prirodan i autentičan karakter objektu.
Kompleks bi obuhvatao 268 apartmanskih jedinica — među kojima su studio, jednosobni i dvosobni apartmani — kao i restoran sa kuhinjom, barom i terasom, spa zonu, te bazenski atrijum sa pažljivo uređenim parternim površinama, kaskadnim potpornih zidovima i žardinjerama.
Garažiranje je planirano na više suterenskih nivoa, uz prateće tehničke i magacinske prostore. Projekat je u fazi traženja investicionih partnera za zajednički razvoj i nastavak realizacije ovog reprezentativnog turističkog kompleksa u Kolašinu.

In Smailagića Polje in Kolašin, the construction of a modern apartment complex with a total gross area of 32,381.94 m² is planned, with a floor plan of Po+Su+Pr+3S+Pk. The area included in the built-up coefficient is 23,374.60 m², while the achieved built-up coefficient is 2.71.
The building is positioned on terrain with a pronounced slope, which directly influenced its form and functional organization. The architectural design is inspired by local vernacular architecture, with a facade clad in wooden slats and decorative meshes, which give the building a natural and authentic character.
The complex would comprise 268 apartment units — including studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments — as well as a restaurant with a kitchen, bar, and terrace, a spa zone, and a pool atrium with carefully landscaped ground-level areas, cascading retaining walls and planters.
Parking is planned on multiple basement levels, along with accompanying technical and storage spaces. The project is in the phase of seeking investment partners for joint development and continued realization of this representative tourist complex in Kolašin.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 44m², Kolašin, Crna Gora
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 44m², Kolašin, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Objekat u izgradnji pozicioniran u samom srcu Kolašina, okružen mnoštvom kafea, restorana, parkova i igrališta. U neposrednoj blizini nalaze se i pošta, dom zdravlja, supermarketi, autobuska stanica i ostali sadržaji koji u mnogome doprinose ugodnom boravku turista kao i svakodnevnim životnim potrebama. Posebna pažnja posvećena je odabiru modernih i kvalitetnih materijala koji su u kombinaciji sa tradicionalnim principima gradnje karakterističnim za ovo podneblje. U skladu sa tim, završna fasadna obloga su u jednom delu talpe od termotretiranog drveta dok je preostali deo fasade prirodni kamen debljine od 5-8cm. U delu koji se obradjuje termotretiranim drvetom, preko zidova od 20cm se postavlja termoizolacioni sloj debljine 15cm preko čega se predvidja sloj za provetravanje od 5cm i kao završni sloj pomenuto termotretirano drvo montrirano na za to predvidjenu podkonstrukciju. Zidovi čiji je finalni sloj kamen su takodje debljine 20cm i sa spoljašnjem delu se preko zida izradjuje sloj betonskog platna.Podovi na svim terasama se oblažu protivkliznom keramikom i izoluju adekvatnom hidroizolacijom.
Dostupne nekretnine u sklopu kompleksa:
- jednosobni stanovi od 44-45-46m2
- dvosobni stanovi od 70m2 i 90m2
- poslovni prostor od 234m2
Kraj radova jun 2027. Cijena iznosi od 2500-2600€/m2.

The property under construction is located in the very heart of Kolašin, surrounded by numerous cafes, restaurants, parks, and playgrounds. In the immediate vicinity are also a post office, health center, supermarkets, bus station, and other amenities that greatly contribute to a pleasant stay for tourists as well as daily life needs. Special attention has been paid to the selection of modern and high-quality materials that are combined with traditional construction principles characteristic of this region. Accordingly, the final facade cladding in one part consists of thermally treated wood panels, while the remaining part of the facade is natural stone with a thickness of 5-8cm. In the section processed with thermally treated wood, a 15cm thick thermal insulation layer is installed over the 20cm walls, followed by a 5cm ventilation layer, and as the final layer, the aforementioned thermally treated wood mounted on the designated substructure. Walls whose final layer is stone are also 20cm thick, and on the exterior part, a layer of concrete canvas is applied over the wall. Floors on all terraces are covered with anti-slip ceramics and insulated with adequate waterproofing.
Available properties within the complex:
- one-bedroom apartments from 44-45-46m2
- two-bedroom apartments from 70m2 and 90m2
- commercial space of 234m2
Completion of works June 2027. Price ranges from 2500-2600€/m2.

listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 265 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje.
Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

A luxury townhouse villa of 220 m² with a private plot of 265 m² and a swimming pool is up for sale. It is located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a memorable view of the Adriatic Sea.
There is a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard on the plot, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property has special advantages — the option of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica.
Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa is a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 45m², Centar, Kolašin
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 45m², Centar, Kolašin
listing.description: Objekat u izgradnji pozicioniran u samom srcu Kolašina, okružen mnoštvom kafea, restorana, parkova i igrališta. U neposrednoj blizini nalaze se i pošta, dom zdravlja, supermarketi, autobuska stanica i ostali sadržaji koji u mnogome doprinose ugodnom boravku turista kao i svakodnevnim životnim potrebama. Posebna pažnja posvećena je odabiru modernih i kvalitetnih materijala koji su u kombinaciji sa tradicionalnim principima gradnje karakterističnim za ovo podneblje. U skladu sa tim, završna fasadna obloga su u jednom delu talpe od termotretiranog drveta dok je preostali deo fasade prirodni kamen debljine od 5-8cm. U delu koji se obradjuje termotretiranim drvetom, preko zidova od 20cm se postavlja termoizolacioni sloj debljine 15cm preko čega se predvidja sloj za provetravanje od 5cm i kao završni sloj pomenuto termotretirano drvo montrirano na za to predvidjenu podkonstrukciju. Zidovi čiji je finalni sloj kamen su takodje debljine 20cm i sa spoljašnjem delu se preko zida izradjuje sloj betonskog platna.Podovi na svim terasama se oblažu protivkliznom keramikom i izoluju adekvatnom hidroizolacijom. Dostupne nekretnine u sklopu kompleksa: - jednosobni stanovi od 44-45-46m2 - dvosobni stanovi od 70m2 i 90m2 - poslovni prostor od 234m2 Cijena iznosi od 2500-2600€/m2.

Property under construction located in the very heart of Kolašin, surrounded by many cafes, restaurants, parks, and playgrounds. In the immediate vicinity there are also a post office, health center, supermarkets, bus station, and other amenities which greatly contribute to a pleasant stay for tourists as well as daily life needs. Special attention has been paid to the selection of modern and quality materials which are combined with traditional construction principles characteristic of this region. Accordingly, the final facade cladding in one part consists of thermally treated wood panels, while the remaining part of the facade is natural stone with a thickness of 5-8cm. In the part treated with thermally treated wood, a 15cm thick thermal insulation layer is installed over the 20cm walls, over which a 5cm ventilation layer is provided, and as a final layer, the aforementioned thermally treated wood is mounted on its designated substructure. Walls whose final layer is stone are also 20cm thick, and on the exterior part, a layer of concrete canvas is applied over the wall. Floors on all terraces are covered with non-slip ceramic tiles and insulated with adequate waterproofing. Available properties within the complex: - one-bedroom apartments from 44-45-46m2 - two-bedroom apartments from 70m2 and 90m2 - commercial space of 234m2 The price ranges from 2500-2600€/m2.

listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 59m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
Sale, two bedroom apartment, 59m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
listing.description:
Objekat je pozicioniran na jednoj od najljepših lokacija u Tivtu. Riječ je o mirnoj lokaciji, na svega 800metara od mora, dok je od centra grada udaljena svega 1 kilometar. Objekat je koncipiran tako, da je svojom dužom stranom orijentisan ka moru, da bi svi stanovi imali otvoren pogled na grad i more. Objekat svojom arhitekturom i formom prati savremen način izgradnje i finalne obrade stambenih objekata. Struktura stanova u ob- jektu, sa mogućnošću objedinjavanja više stambenih jedinica u jednu, budućim korisnici- ma pruža pregršt mogućnosti u odabiru svog doma.
U podzemnim etažama organizovan je cjelokupan mirujući saobraćaj za potrebe korisnika ovog objekta. Pažljivo odabranim sadnicima visokog i niskog rastinja, parterno uređenje oko objekta biće detaljno ozelenjeno, kako bi objekat dodatno ušuškali i oplemenili... Osim navedenog, u parternom uređenju predviđena je izgradnja bazena za korisnike obog objekta...

The building is positioned in one of the most beautiful locations in Tivat. It is a quiet location, only 800 meters from the sea, while it is only 1 kilometer away from the city center. The building is designed so that its longer side is oriented towards the sea, so that all apartments have an open view of the city and the sea. With its architecture and form, the building follows modern construction methods and the final finishing of residential buildings. The structure of apartments in the building, with the possibility of combining several residential units into one, provides future users with a wealth of options in choosing their home.
In the underground floors, all stationary traffic is organized for the needs of the users of this building. With carefully selected tall and low-growing plants, the ground-level landscaping around the building will be thoroughly greened, to further nestle and enhance the building... In addition to the above, the construction of a swimming pool is planned in the ground-level landscaping for the users of this building...

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 42m², Topolica, Bar
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 42m², Topolica, Bar
listing.description:
U ponudi moderan stambeni kompleks savremene arhitekture, projektovan po visokim standardima gradnje i funkcionalnosti.
Objekat je spratnosti -2Po + Pr + 10, i sastoji se od dvije lamele (A i B), sa dvije podzemne etaže namijenjene garažama i ostavama. Stanarima su na raspolaganju recepcije, kao i 6 liftova, uz implementirane smart sisteme za dodatni komfor i sigurnost.
U ponudi su različite strukture stanova:
• jednosobni apartmani: 42,04 – 50,94 m²
• dvosobni apartmani: 83,18 m²
• penthausi: 103,72 – 113,23 m²
Već po cijeni 120.000€ se mogu kupiti jednosobni stanovi. U cijenu stana uključeno parking mjesto.
Kompleks se nalazi na atraktivnoj lokaciji, svega 950 m od centra Bara, na pravcu ka Ulcinju i Velikoj plaži.

On offer is a modern residential complex of contemporary architecture, designed according to high standards of construction and functionality.
The building has -2 underground floors + ground floor + 10 floors, and consists of two blocks (A and B), with two underground floors intended for garages and storage rooms. Receptions are available to residents, as well as 6 elevators, with implemented smart systems for additional comfort and security.
Different apartment structures are available:
• one-bedroom apartments: 42,04 – 50,94 m²
• two-bedroom apartments: 83,18 m²
• penthouses: 103,72 – 113,23 m²
One-bedroom apartments can be purchased starting from 120.000€. A parking space is included in the apartment price.
The complex is located in an attractive location, only 950 m from the center of Bar, on the way towards Ulcinj and Velika plaža.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 5788m², Trebešin, Herceg Novi
Sale, land lot, 5788m², Trebešin, Herceg Novi
listing.description:
Prodaju se započete vile u gruboj gradnji na placu površine 5.788 m², u naselju Trebesin, Herceg Novi. Lokacija se nalazi u neposrednoj blizini magistrale, u području koje ubrzano dobija na vrijednosti i prestižu, zahvaljujući blizini luksuznih kompleksa kao što su Porto Novi i Lazure Marina.
Na parceli je započeta izgradnja vila, pri čemu je svaka vila projektovana na oko 500 m² stambenog prostora, sa planiranim bazenom i prostranim dvorištem. Projekat je osmišljen sa fokusom na luksuz, komfor i savremeni način života, uz mogućnost da budući vlasnik završi objekte prema sopstvenim željama.
Sa placa se pruža otvoren i prelijep pogled na more, što dodatno doprinosi atraktivnosti ove nekretnine.
Udaljenost od mora iznosi oko 4 km, dok su Tivat Airport i Dubrovnik Airport udaljeni približno 25 km i 30 km.

Unfinished villas under rough construction are for sale on a land plot of 5,788 m², in the Trebesin neighborhood, Herceg Novi. The location is in the immediate vicinity of the main road, in an area that is rapidly gaining in value and prestige, thanks to its proximity to luxury complexes such as Porto Novi and Lazure Marina.
Construction of villas has commenced on the land plot, with each villa designed for approximately 500 m² of living space, with a planned swimming pool and a spacious courtyard. The project is designed with a focus on luxury, comfort, and modern lifestyle, with the option for the future owner to complete the properties according to their own wishes.
The land plot offers an open and beautiful sea view, which further adds to the attractiveness of this property.
The distance from the sea is approximately 4 km, while Tivat Airport and Dubrovnik Airport are approximately 25 km and 30 km away.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 17235m², Strp, Kotor

listing.description:
Jedinstvena prilika za kupovinu premium obalnog zemljišta na jednoj od najpoželjnijih lokacija u Crnoj Gori
Smješteno u slikovitom naselju Lipci, u veličanstvenom Bokokotorskom zalivu, ovo izuzetno zemljište predstavlja jedinstvenu investicionu priliku u regionu poznatom po prirodnim ljepotama, ekskluzivnosti i rastućem tržištu luksuznih nekretnina.
Nekretninu čini više povezanih katastarskih parcela ukupne površine 17.235 m², koje zajedno formiraju prostrano imanje sa izuzetnim dugoročnim razvojnim i investicionim potencijalom.
Primarna lokacija
Smješteno uz put koji povezuje Risan i Nikšić Veći dio zemljišta nalazi se na manje od 100 metara od obale Jadranskog mora Okruženo impresivnim pejzažima Bokokotorskog zaliva Odlična povezanost sa Kotorom, Perastom, Tivtom, Porto Montenegrom i međunarodnim aerodromima Mirno okruženje koje pruža privatnost uz blizinu svih važnih sadržaja
Karakteristike nekretnine
Zemljište karakteriše uzdignut i pretežno kamenit teren, tipičan za autentični mediteranski pejzaž koji definiše Bokokotorski zaliv. Prirodna konfiguracija terena omogućava atraktivne vidikovce i jedinstven ambijent koji se rijetko nalazi u neposrednoj blizini mora.
Nekretnina obuhvata kombinaciju šumskog zemljišta, livada i prirodnog kraškog terena, pružajući jedinstven spoj ekološke vrijednosti i investicione atraktivnosti.
Planski status
Zemljište je obuhvaćeno Prostorno-urbanističkim planom Kotora i Prostornim planom posebne namjene za obalno područje Crne Gore.
Nekretnina se nalazi unutar strateški značajne obalne zone koja se prostire do 1.000 metara od obale i pozicionirana je u području predviđenom za buduće plansko uređenje i prostorni razvoj. Detaljne mogućnosti razvoja zavise od pribavljanja urbanističko-tehničkih uslova od nadležnih organa.
17.235 m² premium obalnog zemljišta Prestižna lokacija u Bokokotorskom zalivu Veći dio zemljišta nalazi se na manje od 100 metara od mora
Snažan dugoročni investicioni potencijal Odličan pristup putnoj infrastrukturi

Unique opportunity to purchase premium coastal land in one of the most desirable locations in Montenegro
Located in the picturesque settlement of Lipci, in the magnificent Bokokotorski zaliv, this exceptional land plot represents a unique investment opportunity in a region known for its natural beauty, exclusivity, and growing luxury real estate market.
The property consists of several connected cadastral land plots with a total area of 17,235 m², which together form a spacious estate with exceptional long-term development and investment potential.
Primary location
Located along the road connecting Risan and Nikšić A larger portion of the land is located less than 100 meters from the coast of Jadransko more Surrounded by impressive landscapes of Bokokotorski zaliv Excellent connectivity to Kotor, Perast, Tivat, Porto Montenegro, and international airports Peaceful surroundings providing privacy with proximity to all important amenities
Property characteristics
The land is characterized by elevated and predominantly rocky terrain, typical of the authentic Mediterranean landscape that defines Bokokotorski zaliv. The natural configuration of the terrain allows for attractive viewpoints and a unique ambiance rarely found in the immediate vicinity of the sea.
The property includes a combination of forest land, meadows, and natural karst terrain, providing a unique blend of ecological value and investment attractiveness.
Planning status
The land is covered by the Spatial-Urban Plan of Kotor and the Spatial Plan of Special Purpose for the Coastal Area of Montenegro.
The property is located within a strategically significant coastal zone extending up to 1,000 meters from the coast and is positioned in an area designated for future planning and spatial development. Detailed development possibilities depend on obtaining urban-technical conditions from the competent authorities.
17,235 m² premium coastal land Prestigious location in Bokokotorski zaliv A larger portion of the land is located less than 100 meters from the sea
Strong long-term investment potential Excellent access to road infrastructure

listing.description:

Ukupna površina zemljišta iznosi 18.413 m². Lokacija se odlikuje prirodnim ambijentom i predstavlja dio područja obuhvaćenog važećom prostorno-planskom dokumentacijom Opštine Nikšić.
Prema planskoj namjeni, zemljište se nalazi u zoni šumskih površina, koje su predviđene za očuvanje i unapređenje šumskog fonda, kao i za aktivnosti u funkciji gazdovanja šumama. U okviru ove zone dozvoljena je izgradnja objekata namijenjenih održavanju i unapređenju šumskih resursa, šumskih saobraćajnica, kao i planinarskih i lovačkih domova.
Nekretnina predstavlja interesantnu priliku za investitore i korisnike zainteresovane za zemljište većih površina u prirodnom okruženju, sa potencijalom za razvoj sadržaja usklađenih sa planskom namjenom i principima održivog korišćenja prostora.

The subject property is located in the area of the settlement Šipačno, in the Municipality of Nikšić, in a quiet location approximately 15 kilometers from the city center and about 2.7 kilometers from the main road, which allows connection to the wider transport network.
The total land plot area is 18,413 m². The location is characterized by a natural environment and represents a part of the area covered by the valid spatial planning documentation of the Municipality of Nikšić.
According to the planned use, the land plot is located in a zone of forest areas, which are intended for the preservation and improvement of the forest fund, as well as for activities related to forest management. Within this zone, the construction of facilities intended for the maintenance and improvement of forest resources, forest roads, as well as mountaineering and hunting lodges is permitted.
The property represents an interesting opportunity for investors and users interested in larger land plots in a natural environment, with the potential for developing content aligned with the planned use and principles of sustainable space utilization.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 8662m², Njeguši, Cetinje
Sale, land lot, 8662m², Njeguši, Cetinje
listing.description:
Predmetne nepokretnosti nalaze se na području Njeguša, u Prijestonici Cetinje, u neposrednoj blizini ulazno-kontrolnog punkta Nacionalnog parka Lovćen. Riječ je o atraktivnoj lokaciji prepoznatoj po izuzetnim prirodnim vrijednostima, autentičnom ambijentu i značajnom turističkom potencijalu.
Zemljište je organizovano u više prostornih cjelina, od kojih pojedine imaju direktan pristup lokalnim i regionalnim saobraćajnicama, uključujući putni pravac Kotor–Njeguši–Cetinje, dok se dio površina nalazi u prirodnom okruženju bez neposrednog pristupa javnim putevima.
Prema važećoj prostorno-planskoj dokumentaciji, zemljište obuhvata zone namijenjene stanovanju male gustine, poljoprivrednim površinama, šumama i ostalim prirodnim površinama. Dio lokacija posjeduje potencijal za izgradnju stambenih i pomoćnih objekata, kao i objekata u funkciji poljoprivredne djelatnosti, uz poštovanje urbanističko-tehničkih uslova i važećih planskih ograničenja.
Prirodno okruženje, blizina Nacionalnog parka Lovćen i dobra povezanost sa Cetinjem i Bokokotorskim zalivom daju ovoj nekretnini poseban investicioni značaj. Kombinacija različitih namjena zemljišta pruža mogućnost razvoja sadržaja usklađenih sa principima održivog korišćenja prostora, poljoprivrede i ruralnog turizma.
Zahvaljujući jedinstvenoj lokaciji u jednom od najprepoznatljivijih predjela Crne Gore, predmetne nepokretnosti predstavljaju interesantnu priliku za investitore i korisnike zainteresovane za razvoj projekata u skladu sa prirodnim i prostornim karakteristikama ovog područja.

The subject properties are located in the area of Njeguši, in the Capital City of Cetinje, in the immediate vicinity of the entrance control point of Lovćen National Park. It is an attractive location recognized for its exceptional natural values, authentic ambiance, and significant tourism potential.
The land is organized into several spatial units, some of which have direct access to local and regional roads, including the Kotor–Njeguši–Cetinje road, while some areas are in a natural environment without direct access to public roads.
According to the valid spatial planning documentation, the land includes zones designated for low-density housing, agricultural areas, forests, and other natural areas. Part of the locations have potential for the construction of residential and auxiliary buildings, as well as buildings for agricultural activities, with respect to urban-technical conditions and valid planning restrictions.
The natural environment, the proximity of Lovćen National Park, and good connectivity with Cetinje and Bokokotorski zaliv give this property special investment significance. The combination of different land uses provides the opportunity to develop content aligned with the principles of sustainable spatial use, agriculture, and rural tourism.
Thanks to its unique location in one of the most recognizable regions of Crna Gora, the subject properties represent an interesting opportunity for investors and users interested in developing projects in accordance with the natural and spatial characteristics of this area.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 220m², Reževići, Budva
Sale, house, 220m², Reževići, Budva
listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 154 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 220 m² and a private plot of 154 m² with a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and abundance of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. There is a private pool on the plot, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive the right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

Enterijer i opremljenostUnutrašnjost vile autorski je dizajnirana, sa više scenarija ambijentalnog osvetljenja koji prostoru daju poseban karakter. U završnoj obradi korišćene su italijanske keramičke pločice vrhunskog kvaliteta, dok su kupatila opremljena sanitarnom opremom renomiranih brendova Hansgrohe i Villeroy & Boch.
Vila poseduje savremene sisteme klimatizacije i ventilacije, podno grejanje i kamine, što omogućava prijatan boravak tokom cele godine.
Kvalitet gradnje i energetska efikasnostPrilikom izgradnje posebna pažnja posvećena je termoizolaciji i energetskoj efikasnosti. Ugrađeni su prozori sa dvostrukim zastakljenjem i kvalitetnim profilima renomiranog proizvođača Schüco, čime se doprinosi boljoj toplotnoj i zvučnoj izolaciji.

For sale is a new luxury villa with an area of 200 m², located on a plot of 330 m² in the peaceful and attractive settlement of Krašići, in the municipality of Tivat, just 10 meters from the beach.
Krašići is an ideal location for those who seek privacy, peace and proximity to the sea, far from the hustle and bustle of the city, with a beautiful view of the Boka Bay and the surrounding mountains.
This villa is particularly valuable for its panoramic views of the sea and mountains from every room, a private pool and a carefully designed interior, which combines modern design, quality materials and a high level of comfort.
Interior and equipmentThe interior of the villa is author's designed, with multiple ambient lighting scenarios that give the space a special character. High-quality Italian ceramic tiles were used in the final treatment, while the bathrooms are equipped with sanitary ware from reputable brands Hansgrohe and Villeroy & Boch.
The villa has modern climate control and ventilation systems, underfloor heating and fireplaces, which make it possible to enjoy a pleasant stay throughout the year.
Quality of construction and energy efficiencySpecial attention was paid to thermal insulation and energy efficiency during construction. Double-glazed windows with high-quality profiles from the renowned manufacturer Schüco have been installed, which contribute to better thermal and sound insulation.

Stan se nalazi u ulici Ivana Vujoševića, Preko Morače. Lokacija je izuzetno pogodna za svakodnevni život. Vrtić i osnovna škola nalaze se na svega minut hoda. U neposrednoj blizini nalaze se svi sadržaji neophodni za udoban i praktičan život.

Renoviranje je upravo završeno i u njemu niko nije živio, tako da budući vlasnik dobija potpuno nov, nekorišćen prostor, opremljen luksuznim namještajem.
Stan ima elektronske roletne i multi-split sistem za grijanje i hlađenje, koji obezbjeđuje komfor tokom cijele godine.
Strukturu stana čine komforan hodnik sa ugradnim plakarom, ostava, kupatilo, dnevni boravak, kuhinja sa trpezarijom, spavaća soba i terasa istočne orijentacije.
Posebnu vrijednost nekretnine predstavlja i upisana ostava površine 7 m², koja pruža dodatni prostor za odlaganje.
Ova nekretnina predstavlja odličan izbor za one koji traže kvalitetno uređen stan na vrhunskoj lokaciji, bilo za sopstveno stanovanje ili kao investiciju za izdavanje.

The apartment is located on Ivana Vujoševića street, Preko Morače. The location is extremely convenient for daily life. A kindergarten and elementary school are just a minute's walk away. All amenities necessary for a comfortable and practical life are in the immediate vicinity.
The apartment is located on the second floor of a building with an elevator. The building has access from two sides, which is an additional convenience.
The renovation has just been completed and no one has lived in it, so the future owner receives a completely new, unused space, equipped with luxury furniture.
The apartment has electric blinds and a multi-split system for heating and cooling, which ensures comfort throughout the year.
The apartment's layout consists of a comfortable hallway with a built-in closet, a storage room, a bathroom, a living room, a kitchen with a dining area, a bedroom, and an east-facing terrace.
A special value of the property is the registered storage room of 7 m², which provides additional storage space.
This property represents an excellent choice for those looking for a well-appointed apartment in a prime location, either for their own living or as an investment for rent.

listing.description:
Vero & Versa Residences predstavljaju novu generaciju luksuznog stanovanja u srcu Porto Montenegra.
