Vero & Versa Residences represent a new generation of luxury living in the heart of Porto Montenegro. Located in one of the most desirable locations on the Adriatic, these residences combine contemporary architecture, carefully designed living spaces, and premium amenities, creating an environment where comfort, aesthetics, and the Mediterranean way of life naturally intertwine.
Designed for a life in balance, the project offers a unique living experience through spacious residences, swimming pools, wellness facilities, commercial spaces, and direct connection to the marina, restaurants, boutiques, and all the amenities that make Porto Montenegro one of the most prestigious destinations in the Mediterranean.

listing.title: Stambeni kompleks u Lastvi Grbaljskoj br. 2452
Residential Complex in Lastva Grbaljska
listing.description:
Moderan stambeni kompleks u Budvi pored plaže Jaz
Novi stambeni projekat, smešten u zelenom delu Budve, u podnožju brda Budvanska Lastva. Kompleks uspešno spaja prirodni mir sa blizinom glavnih gradskih i turističkih sadržaja. Samo nekoliko minuta vožnje deli ga od centra Budve, Starog grada, marine, prodavnica, restorana, kao i čuvene plaže Jaz — jedne od najpopularnijih na čitavoj obali Crne Gore.
Projekat se sastoji od šest zasebnih stambenih zgrada, izvedenih u savremenom arhitektonskom stilu sa elementima mediteranske estetike. Korišćeni su visokokvalitetni fasadni materijali, uključujući prirodni kamen, drvo i energetski efikasne tehnologije. Zgrade su projektovane u niskogradnom formatu: sa podzemnim garažama, prizemljem i dva puna nivoa.
Kompleks je deo velikog stambenog i infrastrukturnog projekta, u koji ulaze vile, sportski tereni, zone za odmor, stambeni i komercijalni objekti. Kompleks zauzima centralno mesto u ovoj koncepciji, što ga čini posebno atraktivnim kako za život, tako i za ulaganje.
Stanovi u kompleksu projektovani su sa maksimalnom pažnjom prema komforu. Prostrane terase, funkcionalni rasporedi, velika količina prirodne svetlosti, kvalitetna termo- i zvučna izolacija, savremeni sistemi grejanja i hlađenja — sve to obezbeđuje visok nivo života tokom cele godine.
Trenutno su u prodaji dostupni različiti tipovi stanovanja: kompaktni studiji površine 29 m², 34 m² i 39 m², udobni stanovi sa jednom spavaćom sobom površine 52 m², kao i prostrani apartmani sa dve spavaće sobe površine 88 m². Svi stanovi imaju direktan ili delimičan pogled na more i okolna brda.
Na teritoriji kompleksa biće uređene zone za odmor, zelenilo i parking. Sva neophodna gradska i turistička infrastruktura nalazi se na pešačkoj udaljenosti, a pogodna lokacija čini ovaj kompleks idealnim izborom kako za lično stanovanje, tako i za investicije.
Završetak radova i puštanje objekta u upotrebu planirani su za 1. jul 2027. godine.

Modern residential complex in Kotor
A new residential project located in the green part Kotor. The complex successfully combines natural tranquility with proximity to the main urban and tourist attractions.
The project consists of six separate residential buildings designed in a modern architectural style with elements of Mediterranean aesthetics. High-quality facade materials are used, including natural stone, wood, and energy-efficient technologies. The buildings are designed in a low-rise format: with underground garages, a ground floor, and two full levels.
The complex is part of a large-scale residential and infrastructure project that includes villas, sports grounds, recreation areas, residential and commercial properties. The complex occupies a central place in this concept, which makes it especially attractive both for living and for investment.
The apartments in the complex are designed with maximum attention to comfort. Spacious terraces, well-planned layouts, plenty of natural light, high-quality thermal and sound insulation, modern heating and cooling systems — all this ensures a high standard of living all year round.
At present, various types of housing are available for sale: compact studios of 24 m2. New projects C and D 29-65m2, end of building october 2027. All apartments have direct or partial sea views and views of the surrounding hills.
The complex will feature recreation areas, greenery, and parking. All necessary urban and resort infrastructure is within walking distance, and the convenient location makes this complex an ideal choice both for personal residence and for investment.
The completion date is scheduled for Oct 1, 2027.

listing.description:
Kompleks - Townhouses
Najekskluzivnija kolekcija taunhausa u okviru luksuzne zajednice Luštica Bay. Smješteni na uzvišenju iznad Jadranskog mora i šampionksog golf terena Gary Player Design, taunhausovi stvaraju novi format coastal golf living u Crnoj Gori – kombinaciju privatnosti vile, arhitekture na nivou resort residences i infrastrukture svjetske klase.

Svi taunhausovi se nude u fazi izgradnje sa završetkom radova u decembru 2028. godine.
Svaki taunhaus je dizajniran po konceptu „život unutar i izvan kuće kao jedinstven prostor“ – dnevne zone se neprimjetno prelivaju u prostrane terase, privatne bašte, lounge zone i bazene. Rasporedi odvajaju javne i privatne prostore na dva nivoa, stvarajući osjećaj odvojene vile sa maksimalnim komforom i privatnošću. U mnogim rezidencijama predviđene su dnevne sobe sa dvostrukim svjetlom, kamini, master spavaće sobe sa izlazom na panoramske terase, tehničke prostorije i prostrane zone za odlaganje.

• panoramski pogledi na more i golf teren • privatni bazeni • uređene bašte i ozelenjena unutrašnja dvorišta • ljetne kuhinje i otvorene dining zone • prostrane kamene terase • open-space dnevne sobe i dining zone • kamini u dnevnim sobama • panoramsko zastakljivanje • prirodni premium materijali • dizajnerske kuhinje Nolte ili sličnog premium nivoa • Miele uređaji • podno grijanje u kupatilima • sistemi klimatizacije sa zaštitom od vjetra • privatna parking mjesta • punjači za električna vozila • tehničke prostorije i zone za odlaganje • arhitektura u mediteranskom stilu • visoka privatnost rezidencija • lokacija pored golf clubhouse-a i wellness centra
Prvi stambeni golf kompleks u Crnoj Gori i jedini projekat ovog nivoa u regionu. Centralni dio područja biće prvo 18-rupno šampionkso golf teren u zemlji, razvijeno od strane legendarne kompanije Gary Player Design. Posebnost terena ogleda se u tome što se sa gotovo svake rupe pružaju panoramski pogledi na Jadransko more i Boku Kotorsku – što čini dijelom rijetke kategorije golf zajednica sa morskim pogledima svjetskog nivoa.

The complex - Townhouses
The most exclusive collection of townhouses within the luxury community of Luštica Bay. Perched on an elevation above the Adriatic Sea and the championship Gary Player Design golf course, the complex townhouses create a new format of coastal golf living in Montenegro — a blend of villa privacy, resort-level architecture, and world-class infrastructure.
Available options:
• 3-bedroom townhouses • Area: 184–186 m² • Price: €2,524,000 – €2,643,000
All townhouses are offered at the construction stage, with completion scheduled for December 2028.
Each townhouse is designed with the concept of "indoor and outdoor living as one space" — living areas flow seamlessly into spacious terraces, private gardens, lounge zones, and pools. The layouts separate public and private spaces across two levels, creating the feel of a standalone villa with maximum comfort and privacy. Many residences feature double-height living rooms, fireplaces, master bedrooms with access to panoramic terraces, utility rooms, and ample storage areas.
Townhouse features:
• panoramic views of the sea and golf course • private pools • landscaped gardens and green courtyards • summer kitchens and open dining areas • spacious stone terraces • open-plan living and dining areas • fireplaces in living rooms • panoramic glazing • natural premium materials • designer kitchens by Nolte or similar premium level • Miele appliances • heated floors in bathrooms • air conditioning systems with wind protection • private parking spaces • electric vehicle charging • utility rooms and storage areas • Mediterranean-style architecture • high privacy of residences • location near the golf clubhouse and wellness center
The first residential golf complex in Montenegro and the only project of this caliber in the region. The centerpiece of the area will be the country's first 18-hole championship golf course, designed by the legendary Gary Player Design. The course's unique feature is that nearly every hole offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and the Bay of Kotor — making the complex part of a rare category of golf communities with world-class sea views.
Townhouse owners receive full access to all Luštica Bay infrastructure:

Kompleks kao stambeni kvart sa infrastrukturom za stalni boravak privlači i porodice i investitore orijentisane na dugoročni najam — posebno imajući u vidu da potražnja za kvalitetnim stanovanjem u Lustica Bay stabilno raste zajedno sa razvojem projekta.

We offer for sale a two-bedroom apartment in the area of the Lustica Bay residential complex — a central residential neighborhood with developed everyday infrastructure and free access to Lustica Bay beaches for residents.
Key features:
• Area: 80 m² • Bedrooms: 2 • Bathrooms: 2 • Parking: yes • Modern finishes
About the area:
The complex is the center of everyday life at Lustica Bay: shops, a pharmacy, cafes, restaurants and a lively square right on your doorstep. The area is designed for year-round living, not just seasonal holidays. Residents have free access to Lustica Bay beaches.
Location:
• The complex by Angsana restaurant — on the complex square • Noa Lustica Bay restaurant — about 3.2 km • The Spot at The Chedi — about 2.9 km • The Chedi Lustica Bay beach — about 3.8 km • Tivat Airport — about 10 km • Porto Montenegro — about 9 km
Investment potential:
Lustica Bay is one of the largest development projects on the Adriatic, which continues to actively develop. The complex, as a residential neighborhood with infrastructure for permanent living, attracts both families and investors focused on long-term rentals — especially given that demand for quality housing in Lustica Bay is steadily growing along with the development of the project.

listing.title: Vile u Luštici br. 4020
Villas in Lustica
listing.description:
Kompleks - Golf Villas
Kompleks Villas predstavljaju najekskluzivniju kolekciju rezidencija u okviru luksuzne zajednice Luštica Bay. Smještene na uzvišenju iznad Jadranskog mora i golf terena Gary Player Design, vile stvaraju potpuno novi format coastal golf living u Crnoj Gori - kombinaciju privatnosti, arhitekture na nivou resort rezidencija i infrastrukture svjetske klase.
Dostupne opcije
Vile sa 3 spavaće sobe
• Površina: 275–352 m² • Cijena: €3,442,000 – €4,198,000
Vile sa 4 spavaće sobe
• Površina: 322–386 m² • Cijena: €3,931,000 – €4,232,000
Vile sa 5 spavaćih soba
• Površina: 400 m² • Cijena: €5,076,000
Svaka vila je projektovana po konceptu „život unutar i izvan kuće kao jedinstven prostor" - dnevne zone se glatko prelivaju u prostrane terase, infinity bazene, privatne bašte i otvorene dining zone. U mnogim planovima predviđeni su dnevni boravci sa duplom visinom, master spavaće sobe sa garderobama, prostrana kupatila, kućne kancelarije, tehničke prostorije i podzemne garaže.
Karakteristike vila
• panoramski pogledi na more i golf teren • infinity bazeni • privatne pejzažne bašte • Ljetne kuhinje i sjenice • prostrane kamene terase • open-space dnevni boravci i dining zone • kamini u dnevnim boravcima • panoramsko zastakljivanje • prirodni premium materijali • dizajnerske kuhinje premium nivoa • Miele uređaji • podno grijanje • Privatne garaže i sistemi za skladištenje • kućne kancelarije i tehničke prostorije • arhitektura Block722 • visoka privatnost rezidencija • prostorije za skladištenje opreme za golf
Kompleks je prvi stambeni golf kompleks u Crnoj Gori i jedini projekat ovog nivoa u regionu. Centralni dio područja biće prvo 18-rupa šampionatsko golf teren u zemlji, razvijeno od strane legendarne kompanije Gary Player Design. Posebnost terena je u tome što se sa gotovo svake rupe pruža pogled na more - što ga čini dijelom rijetke kategorije golf terena sa panoramskim morskim pogledima sa svake tačke igre.
Vlasnici vila dobijaju potpuni pristup cjelokupnoj infrastrukturi Luštica Bay:
• privatne plaže i beach klubovi • marina village i šetalište • 5-zvjezdani hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restorani, kafići i butici • golf clubhouse i golf akademija • driving range i golf simulator • spa i wellness sadržaji • teniski i padel tereni • sportski tereni i outdoor teretane • staze za planinarenje i biciklizam • 24-časovno obezbjeđenje i video nadzor • koncijerž i usluge upravljanja nekretninama

The complex - Golf Villas
The complex Villas are the most exclusive collection of residences within the Luštica Bay luxury community. Situated on an elevation above the Adriatic Sea and the Gary Player Design golf course, the villas create a completely new format of coastal golf living in Montenegro — a combination of privacy, resort-level architecture, and world-class infrastructure.
Available Options
3-Bedroom Villas
• Area: 275–352 m² • Price: €3,442,000 – €4,198,000
4-Bedroom Villas
• Area: 322–386 m² • Price: €3,931,000 – €4,232,000
5-Bedroom Villas
• Area: 400 m² • Price: €5,076,000
Each villa is designed according to the concept of "living inside and outside as a single space" — living areas seamlessly flow into spacious terraces, infinity pools, private gardens, and open dining zones. Many layouts feature double-height living rooms, master bedrooms with walk-in closets, spacious bathrooms, home offices, utility rooms, and underground garages.
Villa Features
• panoramic views of the sea and golf course • infinity pools • private landscaped gardens • summer kitchens and gazebos • spacious stone terraces • open-plan living rooms and dining areas • fireplaces in living rooms • floor-to-ceiling glazing • natural premium materials • designer premium kitchens • Miele appliances • underfloor heating • private garages and storage systems • home offices and utility rooms • architecture by Block722 • high privacy of residences • golf equipment storage rooms
The complex is the first residential golf complex in Montenegro and the only project of this level in the region. The centerpiece of the area will be the country's first 18-hole championship golf course, designed by the legendary company Gary Player Design. A unique feature of the course is that almost every hole offers sea views, making it part of a rare category of golf courses with panoramic sea views from every point of play.
Villa owners have full access to all Luštica Bay infrastructure:
• private beaches and beach clubs • marina village and promenade • 5-star hotel The Chedi Luštica Bay • restaurants, cafes, and boutiques • golf clubhouse and golf academy • driving range and golf simulator • spa and wellness facilities • tennis and padel courts • sports fields and outdoor gyms • hiking and biking trails • 24/7 security and video surveillance • concierge and property management services

Modern Residential Complex in Tivat – Your New Home by the Sea
Discover the perfect blend of contemporary architecture, comfort, and Mediterranean lifestyle in an exclusive residential complex located in one of the most beautiful areas of Tivat.
Thoughtfully designed architecture, high-quality materials, and functional layouts create an ideal setting for living, relaxing, or investing on the Montenegrin coast.
The Benefits of Living Here
Attractive Location
The complex is situated in a peaceful, green neighbourhood of Tivat, just a few minutes’ walk from the beaches, restaurants, and the prestigious Porto Montenegro promenade.
High-Quality Finishes
Natural stone, premium sanitary fittings, and air-conditioning systems from renowned international manufacturers ensure a high standard of comfort and aesthetics.
Functional and Light-Filled Spaces
Panoramic windows allow plenty of natural light to enter, while carefully planned layouts ensure optimal use of space.
Professional Property Management
An experienced professional management company will be responsible for overseeing the complex, ensuring easier maintenance and a more comfortable living experience.
Location – Everything You Need Within Easy Reach
Situated in a peaceful part of Tivat, the complex offers the perfect balance between privacy and proximity to essential amenities.
Shops, restaurants, well-maintained beaches, and the Porto Montenegro promenade are all within walking distance. Tivat International Airport is just a ten-minute drive away, making this location particularly convenient for permanent residence, holidays, and year-round living.
Tivat is a city that combines Mediterranean charm, modern infrastructure, and a vibrant lifestyle, offering a unique residential experience on the Adriatic coast.
About the Complex
The development consists of two residential buildings – Block A and Block B – featuring a carefully designed selection of apartments with different layouts.
The available apartments include one- and two-bedroom units, spacious living rooms, and terraces that provide additional space to relax and enjoy the Mediterranean climate.
Ground-floor apartments feature private gardens, ideal for outdoor relaxation and enjoying greater privacy.
Apartment sizes range from 42 m² to 90 m², offering options to suit a variety of needs – from a comfortable home for individuals and couples to a practical solution for families.
Thanks to the panoramic windows, the interiors are filled with natural light, while most apartments offer beautiful views of the sea and the city.
Invest in Quality of Life
Whether you are looking for a new home on the Montenegrin coast, a holiday retreat, or a property with investment potential, this residential complex in Tivat offers an opportunity to enjoy the perfect combination of contemporary living, an attractive location, and a Mediterranean atmosphere.

Area: 79.09 m² · Floor: ground · Bedrooms: 2 · Bathrooms: 3
Exclusive Living in the Heart of Tivat
Discover a collection of beautifully designed apartments in an exclusive residential complex currently under development, ideally located just a short distance from the prestigious Porto Montenegro marina and waterfront district.
Designed to offer an exceptional balance of privacy, comfort, and contemporary elegance, the complex features a secure, gated environment surrounded by carefully planned amenities and inviting communal spaces. It comprises six residential buildings and offers an extensive range of facilities, including a luxurious SPA area with a sauna, steam room, and salt room, a beauty salon, a fully equipped fitness centre, outdoor swimming pools for adults and children, and dedicated children’s playgrounds.
Residents can also enjoy a barbecue area, summer gazebos with open fireplaces, a private cinema room, a karaoke lounge, a meeting room, a café and bakery, and an on-site convenience store. A 24-hour concierge service ensures a seamless and comfortable living experience for both owners and their guests.
Each apartment is offered fully furnished and equipped with modern household appliances, allowing for a smooth move-in experience or immediate use as a holiday residence. Every apartment also benefits from a private storage room located in the underground section of the building, included in the purchase price.
Particular attention has been paid to the quality of construction and interior finishes, with premium materials and carefully selected fittings throughout. Natural wood and stone create a timeless aesthetic, complemented by Samsung WINDFREE air-conditioning systems and prestigious bathroom fixtures by Villeroy & Boch, Kartell LAUFEN, and Dornbracht.
For added convenience, the complex provides ample parking for residents and visitors, with spaces available in both the underground garage and the outdoor parking area.
This development offers an appealing opportunity to enjoy refined Mediterranean living in one of Montenegro’s most desirable coastal destinations, combining modern amenities, elegant interiors, and proximity to the vibrant lifestyle of Porto Montenegro.

Exclusive Living in the Heart of Tivat
Discover a collection of beautifully designed apartments in an exclusive residential complex currently under development, ideally located just a short distance from the prestigious Porto Montenegro marina and waterfront district.
Designed to offer an exceptional balance of privacy, comfort, and contemporary elegance, the complex features a secure, gated environment surrounded by carefully planned amenities and inviting communal spaces. This development offers an appealing opportunity to enjoy refined Mediterranean living in one of Montenegro’s most desirable coastal destinations, combining modern amenities, elegant interiors, and proximity to the vibrant lifestyle of Porto Montenegro.

Exclusive Living in the Heart of Tivat
Discover a collection of beautifully designed apartments in an exclusive residential complex currently under development, ideally located just a short distance from the prestigious Porto Montenegro marina and waterfront district.
Designed to offer an exceptional balance of privacy, comfort, and contemporary elegance, the complex features a secure, gated environment surrounded by carefully planned amenities and inviting communal spaces. It comprises six residential buildings and offers an extensive range of facilities, including a luxurious SPA area with a sauna, steam room, and salt room, a beauty salon, a fully equipped fitness centre, outdoor swimming pools for adults and children, and dedicated children’s playgrounds.
Residents can also enjoy a barbecue area, summer gazebos with open fireplaces, a private cinema room, a karaoke lounge, a meeting room, a café and bakery, and an on-site convenience store. A 24-hour concierge service ensures a seamless and comfortable living experience for both owners and their guests.
Each apartment is offered fully furnished and equipped with modern household appliances, allowing for a smooth move-in experience or immediate use as a holiday residence. Every apartment also benefits from a private storage room located in the underground section of the building, included in the purchase price.
Particular attention has been paid to the quality of construction and interior finishes, with premium materials and carefully selected fittings throughout. Natural wood and stone create a timeless aesthetic, complemented by Samsung WINDFREE air-conditioning systems and prestigious bathroom fixtures by Villeroy & Boch, Kartell LAUFEN, and Dornbracht.
For added convenience, the complex provides ample parking for residents and visitors, with spaces available in both the underground garage and the outdoor parking area.
This development offers an appealing opportunity to enjoy refined Mediterranean living in one of Montenegro’s most desirable coastal destinations, combining modern amenities, elegant interiors, and proximity to the vibrant lifestyle of Porto Montenegro.

listing.title: Investicija u Istri: luksuzni apartman
Investment in Istria: luxury apartment
listing.description:
Na sjeverozapadu Istre, u Savudriji, nalazi se Petram Resort & Residences, najluksuzniji resort na hrvatskoj obali i jedinstven projekt koji spaja suvremenu arhitekturu, vrhunsku udobnost i investicijsku sigurnost. Ovo je mjesto gdje vlasništvo nad apartmanom znači mnogo više od same nekretnine, to je ulazak u svijet prestižnog lifestylea, privatnosti i luksuznog odmora. Vlasnici mogu uživati u svim pogodnostima svjetski poznatog resorta, dok u isto vrijeme ostvaruju stabilan prihod kroz profesionalno organiziran program najma. Petram Resort & Residences zamišljen je kao destinacija za hedoniste, obitelji i investitore koji traže luksuz bez kompromisa.
Apartmani
U glavnoj zgradi resorta smješteno je 179 apartmana različitog tipa. Svi apartmani imaju vlastite terase s pogledom na more ili mediteransko zelenilo, a interijeri su uređeni u suvremenom stilu s naglaskom na eleganciju i prirodne materijale. Svaka jedinica opremljena je modernom kuhinjom, kupaonicama s podnim grijanjem, perilicom i sušilicom rublja, pametnim TV sustavom, sigurnosnim sefom te brzim bežičnim internetom. Posebna pažnja posvećena je detaljima koji stvaraju osjećaj doma i luksuznog hotela u jednom, od kvalitetnih materijala do personaliziranih usluga poput dječje opreme ili sadržaja za kućne ljubimce na zahtjev.
Najam i investicija
Vlasništvo u Petram Resort & Residencesu je pametna investicija. Cijeli kompleks nudi profesionalno upravljanje nekretninama i rental program koji se brine za rezervacije, prijave gostiju, čišćenje, održavanje i marketing. Time se vlasnicima omogućuje potpuno bezbrižno upravljanje apartmanom. Zahvaljujući prestižnoj lokaciji i izuzetno visokoj potražnji za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, apartmani generiraju godišnje prinose od 5 do 7 posto, uz fleksibilnost da vlasnici u odabranim razdobljima uživaju u vlastitom apartmanu. Na taj način nekretnina postaje i osobno zadovoljstvo i izvor stabilnog prihoda.
Resort i lifestyle
Život u Petram Resortu donosi iskustvo najviše svjetske razine. Najveći krovni infinity bazen u Europi, dugačak 105 metara, nudi impresivne poglede na Piranski zaljev i nezaboravne zalaske sunca. Na krovu se smjestio i fine dining restoran koji spaja internacionalnu i istarsku kuhinju, dok ljetna trattoria unosi opušteni talijanski šarm. Spa i wellness centar prostire se na više razina te uključuje unutarnji grijani bazen, pet sauna s panoramskim pogledom na more, luksuzne masažne tretmane i privatne spa apartmane za parove. Resort raspolaže i privatnom plažom, fitness centrom, dječjim bazenima i igralištima, a samo pet minuta udaljen je od najvećeg golf terena u Hrvatskoj s 18 rupa. Vlasnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su i 24-satna recepcija, konsijerž, električni buggy prijevoz unutar resorta, usluga parkiranja i sigurnost na najvišoj razini.
Lokacija
Savudrija, smještena na sjeverozapadnom rtu Istre, poznata je po svojoj tišini, netaknutoj prirodi i bogatoj povijesti. Najstariji svjetionik na Jadranu, čarobni vinogradi i maslinici te šarmantni srednjovjekovni gradići u neposrednoj blizini čine ovu lokaciju posebnom. Savudrija nudi kombinaciju mirnog mediteranskog okruženja i iznimne prometne povezanosti, Trst je udaljen 94 kilometra, Ljubljana 135, Venecija 202, Zagreb 275, a Beč 515 kilometara. Zahvaljujući blizini nekoliko međunarodnih zračnih luka, Petram Resort je lako dostupan klijentima iz cijele Europe, što dodatno povećava atraktivnost investicije.
OPIS APARTMANA
Apartman A-29 – 2. kat – stambena površina 80,80 m2 (2 spavaće sobe + kupaonica + wc) + balkon (10,10 m2 - pogled park) + vanjsko parking mjesto broj 198, obračunska neto površina 88,80 = 756.085,00 EUR (s uključenim namještajem)
Apartmani u Petram Resort & Residences predstavljaju priliku da spojite luksuzni mediteranski život, osobno zadovoljstvo i stabilan prihod od najma, u najluksuznijem resortu na hrvatskoj obali.

In the northwest of Istria, in Savudrija, the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast and a unique project that combines contemporary architecture, top comfort, and investment security. This is a place where apartment ownership means much more than just real estate; it is an entry into a world of prestigious lifestyle, privacy, and luxurious vacation. Owners can enjoy all the amenities of a world-renowned resort while simultaneously generating stable income through a professionally organized rental program. Designed as a destination for hedonists, families, and investors seeking uncompromising luxury.
Apartments
The main resort building houses 179 apartments of various types. All apartments have private terraces with views of the sea or Mediterranean greenery, and the interiors are designed in a contemporary style emphasizing elegance and natural materials. Each unit is equipped with a modern kitchen, bathrooms with underfloor heating, a washer and dryer, a smart TV system, a security safe, and high-speed wireless internet. Special attention is given to details that create a feeling of home and luxury hotel combined, from high-quality materials to personalized services such as children's equipment or pet amenities upon request.
Rental and Investment
Ownership is a smart investment. The entire complex offers professional property management and a rental program that handles bookings, guest check-ins, cleaning, maintenance, and marketing. This allows owners completely worry-free apartment management. Thanks to the prestigious location and exceptionally high demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, the apartments generate annual returns of 5 to 7 percent, with the flexibility for owners to enjoy their apartment during selected periods. This way, the property becomes both a personal pleasure and a source of stable income.
Resort and Lifestyle
Living at Resort offers an experience of the highest global standards. The largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe, 105 meters long, offers impressive views of the Piran Bay and unforgettable sunsets. On the roof, there is also a fine dining restaurant combining international and Istrian cuisine, while the summer trattoria brings a relaxed Italian charm. The spa and wellness center spans multiple levels and includes an indoor heated pool, five saunas with panoramic sea views, luxurious massage treatments, and private spa apartments for couples. The resort also features a private beach, fitness center, children's pools, and playgrounds, and is only five minutes away from the largest golf course in Croatia with 18 holes. Owners and guests have access to 24-hour reception, concierge service, electric buggy transport within the resort, parking services, and top-level security.
Location
Savudrija, located on the northwestern tip of Istria, is known for its tranquility, unspoiled nature, and rich history. The oldest lighthouse on the Adriatic, enchanting vineyards and olive groves, and charming medieval towns in the immediate vicinity make this location special. Savudrija offers a combination of a peaceful Mediterranean environment and excellent transport connections; Trieste is 94 kilometers away, Ljubljana 135, Venice 202, Zagreb 275, and Vienna 515 kilometers. Thanks to the proximity of several international airports. APARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Apartment A-29 – 2nd floor – living area 80.80 m2 (2 bedrooms + bathroom + WC) + balcony (10.10 m2 - park view) + outdoor parking space number 198, calculated net area 88.80 = 756,085.00 EUR (including furniture)
Apartments at Resort represent an opportunity to combine luxurious Mediterranean living, personal satisfaction, and stable rental income in the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast.

Svaka jedinica opremljena je modernom kuhinjom, kupaonicama s podnim grijanjem, perilicom i sušilicom rublja, pametnim TV sustavom, sigurnosnim sefom te brzim bežičnim internetom. Posebna pažnja posvećena je detaljima koji stvaraju osjećaj doma i luksuznog hotela u jednom, od kvalitetnih materijala do personaliziranih usluga poput dječje opreme ili sadržaja za kućne ljubimce na zahtjev.
Najam i investicija
Vlasništvo u Petram Resort & Residencesu je pametna investicija. Cijeli kompleks nudi profesionalno upravljanje nekretninama i rental program koji se brine za rezervacije, prijave gostiju, čišćenje, održavanje i marketing. Time se vlasnicima omogućuje potpuno bezbrižno upravljanje apartmanom. Zahvaljujući prestižnoj lokaciji i izuzetno visokoj potražnji za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, apartmani generiraju godišnje prinose od 5 do 7 posto, uz fleksibilnost da vlasnici u odabranim razdobljima uživaju u vlastitom apartmanu. Na taj način nekretnina postaje i osobno zadovoljstvo i izvor stabilnog prihoda.
Resort i lifestyle
Život u Petram Resortu donosi iskustvo najviše svjetske razine. Najveći krovni infinity bazen u Europi, dugačak 105 metara, nudi impresivne poglede na Piranski zaljev i nezaboravne zalaske sunca. Na krovu se smjestio i fine dining restoran koji spaja internacionalnu i istarsku kuhinju, dok ljetna trattoria unosi opušteni talijanski šarm. Spa i wellness centar prostire se na više razina te uključuje unutarnji grijani bazen, pet sauna s panoramskim pogledom na more, luksuzne masažne tretmane i privatne spa apartmane za parove. Resort raspolaže i privatnom plažom, fitness centrom, dječjim bazenima i igralištima, a samo pet minuta udaljen je od najvećeg golf terena u Hrvatskoj s 18 rupa. Vlasnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su i 24-satna recepcija, konsijerž, električni buggy prijevoz unutar resorta, usluga parkiranja i sigurnost na najvišoj razini.
Lokacija
Savudrija, smještena na sjeverozapadnom rtu Istre, poznata je po svojoj tišini, netaknutoj prirodi i bogatoj povijesti. Najstariji svjetionik na Jadranu, čarobni vinogradi i maslinici te šarmantni srednjovjekovni gradići u neposrednoj blizini čine ovu lokaciju posebnom. Savudrija nudi kombinaciju mirnog mediteranskog okruženja i iznimne prometne povezanosti, Trst je udaljen 94 kilometra, Ljubljana 135, Venecija 202, Zagreb 275, a Beč 515 kilometara. Zahvaljujući blizini nekoliko međunarodnih zračnih luka, Petram Resort je lako dostupan klijentima iz cijele Europe, što dodatno povećava atraktivnost investicije.
OPIS APARTMANA
Apartman C-03 – prizemlje – stambena površina 47,50 m2 (1 spavaća soba + kupaonica) + balkon (13,80 m2 - pogled park) + vanjsko parking mjesto, obračunska neto površina 60,85 = 459.750,00 EUR (s uključenim namještajem)
Apartmani u Petram Resort & Residences predstavljaju priliku da spojite luksuzni mediteranski život, osobno zadovoljstvo i stabilan prihod od najma, u najluksuznijem resortu na hrvatskoj obali.

Located in Savudrija, in northwest Istria, this luxury resort combines contemporary architecture, Mediterranean comfort, and investment potential. Owners can enjoy the resort’s amenities and use a professional rental program to manage bookings, guest services, cleaning, and maintenance.
The main building features 179 apartments with private terraces, modern kitchens, underfloor-heated bathrooms, washer-dryers, smart TVs, safes, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Personal touches and family- and pet-friendly amenities are available on request.
The resort offers a 105-metre rooftop infinity pool, restaurants, a multi-level spa and wellness centre, private beach, fitness facilities, children’s pools and playgrounds, and electric buggy transport. An 18-hole golf course is just five minutes away.
Savudrija is known for its peaceful Mediterranean setting, historic lighthouse, vineyards, olive groves, and nearby medieval towns. Its location also offers convenient connections to cities and international airports across the region.
**Apartment C-03** is on the ground floor and includes a 47.50 m² living area with one bedroom and a bathroom, a 13.80 m² balcony overlooking the park, and an outdoor parking space. The calculated net area is 60.85 m². **Price: €459,750, including furniture.**

In the northwest of Istria, in Savudrija, the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast and a unique project that combines contemporary architecture, top comfort, and investment security. This is a place where apartment ownership means much more than just real estate; it is an entry into a world of prestigious lifestyle, privacy, and luxurious vacation. Owners can enjoy all the amenities of a world-renowned resort while simultaneously generating stable income through a professionally organized rental program. Resort is designed as a destination for hedonists, families, and investors seeking uncompromising luxury.
Apartments
The main resort building houses 179 apartments of various types. All apartments have private terraces with views of the sea or Mediterranean greenery, and the interiors are decorated in a contemporary style emphasizing elegance and natural materials. Each unit is equipped with a modern kitchen, bathrooms with underfloor heating, a washer and dryer, a smart TV system, a safety deposit box, and high-speed wireless internet. Special attention is given to details that create a feeling of home and luxury hotel combined, from high-quality materials to personalized services such as children's equipment or pet amenities upon request.
Rental and Investment
Ownership is a smart investment. The entire complex offers professional property management and a rental program that takes care of bookings, guest check-ins, cleaning, maintenance, and marketing. This allows owners completely worry-free management of their apartments. Thanks to the prestigious location and extremely high demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, the apartments generate annual returns of 5 to 7 percent, with the flexibility for owners to enjoy their own apartment during selected periods. In this way, the property becomes both a personal pleasure and a source of stable income.
Resort and Lifestyle
Living at Resort offers an experience of the highest global standards. The largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe, 105 meters long, provides impressive views of the Piran Bay and unforgettable sunsets. On the roof is also a fine dining restaurant combining international and Istrian cuisine, while the summer trattoria brings a relaxed Italian charm. The spa and wellness center spans multiple levels and includes an indoor heated pool, five saunas with panoramic sea views, luxurious massage treatments, and private spa apartments for couples. The resort also features a private beach, fitness center, children's pools and playgrounds, and is only five minutes away from the largest golf course in Croatia with 18 holes. Owners and guests have access to 24-hour reception, concierge service, electric buggy transport within the resort, parking service, and top-level security.
Location
Savudrija, located on the northwestern tip of Istria, is known for its tranquility, unspoiled nature, and rich history. The oldest lighthouse on the Adriatic, magical vineyards and olive groves, and charming medieval towns in the immediate vicinity make this location special. Savudrija offers a combination of peaceful Mediterranean surroundings and excellent transport connections; Trieste is 94 kilometers away, Ljubljana 135, Venice 202, Zagreb 275, and Vienna 515 kilometers. Thanks to the proximity of several international airports,

Apartments represent an opportunity to combine luxurious Mediterranean living, personal satisfaction, and stable rental income in the most luxurious resort on the Croatian coast.

listing.title: Ekskluzivna vila u Istri - spoj luksuza i investicije
Exclusive villa in Istria - a combination of luxury and investment
listing.description:
Na prestižnoj lokaciji u neposrednoj blizini mora, u Istri, smješten je Petram Resort & Residences, projekt koji postavlja nove standarde luksuza na Jadranu. Resort nudi 55 ekskluzivnih vila zamišljene kao privatne baze za one koji traže apsolutnu udobnost, sigurnost i prestiž. Svaka vila pruža spoj vrhunskog dizajna, suvremenih tehnologija i jedinstvene pozicije, dok vlasnicima omogućuje i atraktivnu investicijsku priliku kroz profesionalno vođen program najma.
Kupnjom vile u Petram Resortu ne ulažete samo u nekretninu, već u životni stil koji kombinira privatnost, luksuz i potpuni užitak u svim sadržajima jednog od najekskluzivnijih resorta u Hrvatskoj.
Vile
Ponuda uključuje različite tipove vila, površine od 220 do 380 m2 raspoređenih tako da osiguraju maksimalnu privatnost i spektakularne poglede. Dvanaest vila ima vlastite infinity bazene na krovnim terasama, dok ostale nude prostrane privatne vrtove i terase savršene za odmor i druženje. Svaka vila pažljivo je integrirana u mediteranski ambijent, s naglaskom na prirodne materijale, prostrane staklene stijene i otvorene tlocrte koji spajaju interijer s eksterijerom.
Unutrašnjost vila dizajnirana je da pruži apsolutnu udobnost. Prostrane spavaće sobe, više luksuzno opremljenih kupaonica, elegantni dnevni boravci i potpuno opremljene kuhinje čine ih idealnim mjestom i za privatni boravak i za luksuzni turistički najam.
Najam i investicija
Vile u Petram Resortu kombiniraju prestiž vlasništva i sigurnost investicije. Profesionalni tim resorta brine o kompletnom upravljanju, od marketinga i rezervacija, do čišćenja, održavanja i prijave gostiju. Vlasnicima to donosi potpuno bezbrižno iskustvo i stabilne godišnje prihode. S obzirom na rastuću potražnju za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, očekivani prinosi su izuzetno atraktivni, dok sama nekretnina dugoročno čuva i povećava vrijednost. Vlasnici pritom imaju fleksibilnost korištenja vile za osobni odmor kad god to požele.
Resort i lifestyle
Kupnja vile u Petram Resort & Residences znači pristup svim sadržajima koji čine ovaj kompleks jedinstvenim. Vlasnici uživaju u najvećem krovnom infinity bazenu u Europi, ekskluzivnom spa i wellness centru s unutarnjim bazenima i panoramskim saunama, privatnoj plaži, rooftop restoranima, talijanskoj trattoriji i brojnim gourmet iskustvima. Ljubitelji sporta imaju na raspolaganju teniske terene, teretanu s pogledom na more i golf teren s 18 rupa udaljen svega nekoliko minuta. Resort pruža i vrhunsku sigurnost s 24/7 zaštitom, uslugom konsijerža, valet parkingom, transferima prema zračnim lukama i prijevozom unutar kompleksa električnim vozilima.
O Savudriji
Savudrija, najsjevernija točka Istre, mjesto je gdje priroda, povijest i moderni luksuz stvaraju jedinstvenu harmoniju. Ovdje se nalaze vinogradi, maslinici i srednjovjekovni istarski gradići, a regija je poznata i po svojoj vrhunskoj gastronomiji. Savudrija je idealna za miran i profinjen odmor, ali i savršeno povezana s Europom: Venecija, Ljubljana, Zagreb i Beč udaljeni su samo nekoliko sati vožnje, dok se u blizini nalazi i nekoliko međunarodnih zračnih luka. Upravo ta kombinacija autentičnog istarskog šarma i izvanredne dostupnosti čini Petram Resort savršenim izborom za vlasnike vila i njihove goste.
OPIS VILE
VILA TIP1 – suteren, prizemlje i kat – stambena površina 190,27 m2 (2 spavaće sobe + 2 kupaonice + wc + studio apartman + igraonica + ostava) + balkon (25 m2) + terasa (45 m2) + vrt (198 m2) + vanjsko parking mjesto, obračunska neto površina 282,79 m2 = 1.746.375,00 EUR (s uključenim namještajem)
Vile u Petram Resort & Residences predstavljaju rijetku priliku za vlasništvo na najprestižnijoj lokaciji u Istri. To je spoj privatnosti, luksuza i pametnog investiranja, koji istovremeno pruža savršen prostor za visoku kvalitetu života i pouzdani izvor prihoda.

In a prestigious location in the immediate vicinity of the sea, in Istria, is situated, a project that sets new standards of luxury on the Adriatic. The resort offers 55 exclusive villas designed as private bases for those seeking absolute comfort, security, and prestige. Each villa provides a combination of top-level design, modern technologies, and a unique position, while also offering owners an attractive investment opportunity through a professionally managed rental program.
By purchasing a villa, you are investing not only in real estate but also in a lifestyle that combines privacy, luxury, and complete enjoyment of all the amenities of one of the most exclusive resorts in Croatia.
Villas
The offer includes various types of villas, with areas ranging from 220 to 380 m2, arranged to ensure maximum privacy and spectacular views. Twelve villas have their own infinity pools on rooftop terraces, while the others offer spacious private gardens and terraces perfect for relaxation and socializing. Each villa is carefully integrated into the Mediterranean environment, emphasizing natural materials, large glass walls, and open floor plans that connect the interior with the exterior.
The interiors of the villas are designed to provide absolute comfort. Spacious bedrooms, multiple luxuriously equipped bathrooms, elegant living rooms, and fully equipped kitchens make them ideal both for private residence and luxury tourist rental.
Rental and Investment
The villas in Resort combine the prestige of ownership with investment security. The resort’s professional team takes care of complete management, from marketing and bookings to cleaning, maintenance, and guest registration. This provides owners with a completely worry-free experience and stable annual income. Given the growing demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, expected returns are highly attractive, while the property itself preserves and increases its value in the long term. Owners also have the flexibility to use the villa for personal vacations whenever they wish.
Resort and Lifestyle
Purchasing a villa in Resort means access to all the amenities that make this complex unique. Owners enjoy the largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe, an exclusive spa and wellness center with indoor pools and panoramic saunas, a private beach, rooftop restaurants, an Italian trattoria, and numerous gourmet experiences. Sports enthusiasts have access to tennis courts, a gym with sea views, and an 18-hole golf course just minutes away. The resort also provides top-level security with 24/7 protection, concierge service, valet parking, airport transfers, and transportation within the complex by electric vehicles.
About Savudrija
Savudrija, the northernmost point of Istria, is a place where nature, history, and modern luxury create a unique harmony. Here you will find vineyards, olive groves, and medieval Istrian towns, and the region is also known for its top gastronomy. Savudrija is ideal for a peaceful and refined vacation but also perfectly connected to Europe: Venice, Ljubljana, Zagreb, and Vienna are only a few hours’ drive away, and several international airports are nearby. This combination of authentic Istrian charm and excellent accessibility makes Petram Resort a perfect choice for villa owners and their guests.
VILLA DESCRIPTION
VILLA TYPE 1 – basement, ground floor, and first floor – living area 190.27 m2 (2 bedrooms + 2 bathrooms + WC + studio apartment + playroom + storage) + balcony (25 m2) + terrace (45 m2) + garden (198 m2) + outdoor parking space, calculated net area 282.79 m2 = 1,746,375.00 EUR (including furniture)
Villas represent a rare opportunity for ownership in the most prestigious location in Istria. It is a combination of privacy, luxury, and smart investing, which simultaneously provides a perfect space for a high quality of life and a reliable source of income.

listing.title: Stan (89 m2) - kvaliteta života u Istri
Apartment (89 m2) – quality of life in Istria
listing.description:
sklopu Petram Resort & Residences nalaze se tri elegantne stambene zgrade s ukupno osamnaest stanova za one koji žele spoj mirnog života i svih pogodnosti vrhunskog resorta. Stanovi predstavljaju jedinstvenu priliku za život u privatnom okruženju uz neposredan pristup sadržajima svjetske klase. Ovo je rješenje za one koji traže luksuzan apartman na moru, bilo za stalni boravak ili kao destinaciju za odmor, uz dodatnu prednost stabilne investicije kroz model najma.
Stanovi
Tri niske stambene zgrade smještene u zelenilu imaju šest stanova po objektu, čime se osigurava mir i privatnost. Stanovi su pažljivo projektirani, od dvosobnih do prostranih dvoetažnih jedinica. Svaki stan ima vlastitu terasu ili loggiu, suvremeno uređene interijere i maksimalnu funkcionalnost. Uređenje interijera temelji se na kombinaciji modernog dizajna i mediteranskog duha, s prostranim dnevnim boravcima, prirodnim svjetlom i vrhunskim materijalima.
Najam i investicija
Stanovi u Petram Resortu nude mogućnost sudjelovanja u profesionalnom programu upravljanja i najma. Vlasnici mogu prepustiti kompletnu brigu o svojoj nekretnini iskusnom timu resorta i pritom ostvarivati atraktivne godišnje prihode. S obzirom na visoku potražnju za luksuznim smještajem u Istri, očekivani prinosi kreću se u rasponu od 5 do 7 posto, a istovremeno vlasnici zadržavaju fleksibilnost da koriste stan u razdobljima koja im odgovaraju. Upravo ova kombinacija sigurnog prihoda i osobne koristi čini stanove odličnom investicijom za dugoročno očuvanje i rast vrijednosti.
Resort i lifestyle
Stanovi imaju prednost intimnog stanovanja, ali i potpunu uključenost u život Petram Resorta. Vlasnici mogu uživati u istim pogodnostima kao i gosti apartmana i vila, od najvećeg krovnog infinity bazena u Europi, do privatne plaže, wellness i spa centra, vrhunskih restorana i sportskih sadržaja. Obitelji s djecom cijene sigurnost zatvorene zajednice, obiteljske sadržaje i bogate programe za djecu, dok ljubitelji aktivnog života uživaju u golfu, tenisu i biciklističkim rutama kroz istarsko zelenilo.
O Savudriji
Savudrija, tiho ribarsko mjesto na krajnjem sjeveru Istre, posljednjih godina je izraslo u prestižnu destinaciju. Osim što je poznata po najstarijem svjetioniku na Jadranu i čuvenim zalascima sunca, regija nudi bogatu gastronomsku i vinsku scenu, maslinova ulja svjetske klase i brojne kulturne manifestacije tijekom cijele godine. Blizina gradova poput Trsta, Ljubljane i Venecije, kao i odlična prometna povezanost s cijelom Europom, čine ovu lokaciju savršenom za vlasnike koji žele uživati u autentičnom mediteranskom životu, a istovremeno zadržati jednostavan pristup svojim domovima.
OPIS STANA
Stan A1-S2 – prizemlje – stambena površina 74,76 m2 (2 spavaće sobe + 2 kupaonice + wc) + terasa (20 m2) + vrt (75,85 m2) + vanjsko parking mjesto, obračunska neto površina 89,84 = 452.793,00 EUR
Stanovi u Petram Resort & Residences pružaju rijetku kombinaciju luksuznog stanovanja, privatnosti i pristup jednom od najprestižnijih resorta u regiji. Ovo je investicija koja nudi sigurnost, stabilan prihod i visoku kvalitetu života.

There are three elegant residential buildings with a total of eighteen apartments for those who want to combine peaceful living with all the amenities of a top-class resort. The apartments represent a unique opportunity to live in a private environment with direct access to world-class facilities. This is a solution for those seeking a luxury seaside apartment, either for permanent residence or as a holiday destination, with the added advantage of a stable investment through a rental model.
Apartments
Three low-rise residential buildings set in greenery each have six apartments, ensuring peace and privacy. The apartments are carefully designed, ranging from two-bedroom units to spacious duplexes. Each apartment has its own terrace or loggia, modern interiors, and maximum functionality. The interior design is based on a combination of modern style and Mediterranean spirit, with spacious living rooms, natural light, and premium materials.
Rental and Investment
The apartments in offer the possibility to participate in a professional management and rental program. Owners can entrust the complete care of their property to the experienced resort team and earn attractive annual income. Given the high demand for luxury accommodation in Istria, expected returns range from 5 to 7 percent, while owners retain the flexibility to use the apartment during periods that suit them. This combination of secure income and personal use makes the apartments an excellent investment for long-term preservation and growth of value.
Resort and Lifestyle
The apartments offer the advantage of intimate living while being fully integrated into the life of Resort. Owners can enjoy the same benefits as guests of the apartments and villas, from the largest rooftop infinity pool in Europe to a private beach, wellness and spa center, top restaurants, and sports facilities. Families with children appreciate the safety of the gated community, family amenities, and rich children’s programs, while active lifestyle enthusiasts enjoy golf, tennis, and cycling routes through Istrian greenery.
About Savudrija
Savudrija, a quiet fishing village at the northern tip of Istria, has grown in recent years into a prestigious destination. Besides being known for the oldest lighthouse on the Adriatic and famous sunsets, the region offers a rich gastronomic and wine scene, world-class olive oils, and numerous cultural events throughout the year. The proximity to cities like Trieste, Ljubljana, and Venice, as well as excellent transport connections to all of Europe, make this location perfect for owners who want to enjoy authentic Mediterranean living while maintaining easy access to their homes.
APARTMENT DESCRIPTION
Apartment A1-S2 – ground floor – living area 74.76 m2 (2 bedrooms + 2 bathrooms + WC) + terrace (20 m2) + garden (75.85 m2) + outdoor parking space, calculated net area 89.84 = 452,793.00 EUR
The apartments provide a rare combination of luxury living, privacy, and access to one of the most prestigious resorts in the region. This is an investment offering security, stable income, and a high quality of life.

listing.title: Stan sa jednom spavaćom sobom, Vero Residences
Vero Residences 1 bedroom Apartment
listing.description:
Površina: 67 m2 (58 m2 + terasa 9 m2)
Spavaćih soba: 1
Kupatila: 1
Garaža
Jednosoban stan u potpuno novoj stambenoj zgradi Vero u Porto Montenegru.
Stan će imati otvoren dnevni prostor i trpezariju sa kuhinjom, spavaću sobu, kupatilo i terasu. I iz dnevnog boravka i iz spavaće sobe izlazi se na terasu sa pogledom na Boka Place.
Apartman će imati opremljenu kuhinju, kao i ugradni ormar
Vlasnici će imati mogućnost da izaberu potpuno prilagođene pakete namještaja od Manor Interior Design, sa fiksnim cijenama do juna 2026.
Vero Residences obuhvata 155 modernih stanova, od studija do penthausa sa tri spavaće sobe, pažljivo dizajniranih da odgovaraju različitim stilovima života. The property represents a private residence with a total area of 1003,26 m2 featuring 7 bedrooms and positioned as a rare trophy asset within one of the most prestigious buildings in Porto Montenegro marina.
The residence comprises two expansive living rooms with dining areas and kitchens, seven en-suite bedrooms, guest toilets, and multiple large terraces that open to spectacular views of the Bay of Kotor, Mount Lovćen, Tivat, and the Porto Montenegro marina. The layout is designed to allow flexible use while maintaining full functional independence of the two original penthouses.
Each penthouse retains its own private entrance via dedicated elevator access, further enhancing privacy and exclusivity. On the rooftop, there are two private rooftop terraces featuring two “infinity” swimming pools exclusively for the owners, as well as two fully equipped outdoor kitchens and two wood-burning fireplace zones, creating a unique outdoor living and entertainment environment.
The price includes a total of four garage spaces and three storage units, adding further comfort and practicality to the residence.
Elena Residences is one of the most sought-after buildings within Porto Montenegro, recognized for its contemporary architecture, high-end standard of living, and strong investment potential. Porto Montenegro, as a world-class marina, offers a luxury lifestyle concept with premium residences, hotels, restaurants, and boutiques.
This property is positioned as a truly unique offering on the market, a rare example of a private half-floor residence of this scale, featuring 7 bedrooms and dual rooftop amenities. Its value is further enhanced by 270-degree panoramic views and its location within a fully completed part of the masterplan, with no future construction that could impact the views or surroundings.

listing.title: Penthaus Regent Signature
Signature Regent Penthouse
listing.description:
Površina: 620 m2 (320 m2 unutrašnje + terasa 300 m2)
Spavaće sobe: 4
Kupatila: 4 + 1
Jedinstven penthaus sa panoramskim pogledom u luksuznom stambenom kompleksu i marini za mega jahte Porto Montenegro. Stan je dio hotela Regent sa 5 zvjezdica, ukupne površine 620 m2 (320 m2 unutrašnje površine i terasa od 300 m2).
Ova elegantna nekretnina ima četiri spavaće sobe, 4 kupatila, toalet za goste, veliki dnevni boravak, odvojenu kuhinju i trpezariju, kao i veliku terasu okrenutu moru, koja okružuje stan sa svih strana, sa bazenom.
Stan se prodaje potpuno namješten, u skladu sa najvišim standardima hotela Regent. Savršeno je smješten na vrhu istočnog krila hotela, pa sa prostrane terase u potpunosti pruža spektakularan pogled na more i cijeli Tivatski zaliv. Penthaus ima i direktan pristup dvama bazenima, spa centru, teretani i vrhunskim restoranima hotela Regent.
Porto Montenegro je živa luksuzna marina za mega jahte na samoj obali, nekoliko minuta od centra Tivta, sa dugim šetalištem i lijepom obalom. Osim hotela Regent i vezova za plovila, Porto Montenegro nudi i nekoliko prepoznatljivih restorana, zanimljive kafiće, šoping zonu, prodavnicu, luksuzni bazen itd. – sve na nekoliko minuta hoda od stana.
Kompleks je povoljno smješten između dva glavna regionalna primorska aerodroma – samo 5 km od aerodroma Tivat i manje od 40 km od aerodroma Dubrovnik.
Kotor, sa Starim gradom pod zaštitom UNESCO-a, udaljen je 12 km.

Area: 620 m2 (320 m2 internal + 300 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 4
Bathrooms: 4 + 1
A unique penthouse apartment, with panoramic views, within the Porto Montenegro luxury residential complex and mega yacht marina. The apartment is a part of the Regent 5 * hotel with a total area of 620m2, (320 m2 of internal area and 300 m2 terrace).
This elegant and stylish property comprises of four bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a guest toilet, a large living room, a separate kitchen and dining room, and a large terrace facing the sea, surrounding the apartment from all sides, with a swimming pool.
The apartment is sold entirely furnished, in accordance with the Regent Hotel’s highest standards. It is perfectly positioned, on top of the eastern wing of the Regent Hotel, thus maximizing all benefits from the spectacular views of the sea and the entire Bay of Tivat from its spacious terrace. Also, the penthouse features direct access to two pools, a SPA center, a gym, and Regent Hotel premium restaurants.
Porto Montenegro is a vibrant luxury marina for mega yachts, situated on the waterfront, just minutes away from the Tivat city center with a long promenade and beautiful coastline. Besides the Regent Hotel and the boat moorings, Porto Montenegro also offers several signature restaurants, interesting café-bars, a shopping village, a grocery store, a luxury swimming pool, etc… all within several minutes of walk away from the apartment.
The complex is conveniently located between two main regional coastal airports – it is only 5km from the airport in Tivat and less than 40km from Dubrovnik airport.
Kotor, with UNESCO-protected Old Town, is 12km away.

listing.description:
Površina: 58 m2 (47 m2 + terasa 5 m2 + 6 m2 u isključivom korišćenju)
Kupatila: 1
Garaža
Studio u potpuno novoj stambenoj zgradi Versa u Porto Montenegru.
Stan će imati otvoren dnevni prostor i trpezariju sa kuhinjom, kupatilo i terasu. Iz dnevnog boravka izlaziće se na terasu sa pogledom na Boka Place.
Stan će imati opremljenu kuhinju.
Vlasnici će imati mogućnost da izaberu potpuno prilagođene pakete namještaja od Manor Interior Design, sa fiksnim cijenama do juna 2026.
Versa Residences je intimna kolekcija od 47 promišljeno osmišljenih stanova – studija, jednosobnih i dvosobnih – nastalih sa fokusom na ravnotežu, velnes i svakodnevnu udobnost. Stanari koriste prijatnu recepciju, bazen na podijumu sa zadivljujućim pogledom i dobro opremljenu teretanu na prvom spratu, a parking u kompleksu obezbjeđuje lak pristup i svakodnevnu udobnost.
